commitment: Upgrade and protect the Shrine of Remembrance
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will:
• Invest $29 million to upgrade the Shrine of Remembrance to honour [veterans who served after 1975] with a new memorial.
• Include a new accessible path linking the Shrine to Anzac Station.
• Upgrade the visitor centre for the growing numbers of tourists, school groups, tours and veterans’ organisations visiting the Shrine.
• Protect the Shrine itself, preserving it for generations to come. Conservation works will include repairing the 91-year-old roof.
• Establish an annual capital renewal fund for ongoing maintenance, and boost operational funding to continue supporting the Shrine."

commitment: Duplicate the Vineyard Road overpass between Sunbury and Diggers Rest
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will get Sunbury and Diggers Rest locals moving under a new commitment to duplicate the Vineyard Road overpass." "This upgrade will cost $166 million."

commitment: Ban convicted family violence or sexual offenders from using dating apps
specification: "Labor will ban people convicted of family violence or sexual offences from using dating apps. It will be a criminal offence."

commitment: Ban smart glasses in sensitive settings
specification: "Labor will ban smart glasses in places where creeps could use them to prey on women and children – like swimming pools, change rooms and community sporting venues. To protect people at risk, we’ll also ban them in sensitive settings like hospitals, aged care facilities, and family violence and victim services."

commitment: Fund more family violence workers and early intervention programs
specification: "We’ll invest $15.5 million in the Orange Door to boost staff and resources. We will also invest $16 million for a new Early Intervention and Prevention Fund."

commitment: Give coroners the power to appoint an alternative next of kin
specification: "Labor will give coroners the power to appoint an alternative next of kin in cases involving domestic violence allegations, charges or estrangement."

commitment: Introduce Clare’s Law to establish a domestic violence disclosure scheme
specification: "Labor will introduce Clare’s Law and deliver Victoria’s first domestic violence disclosure scheme. This scheme will let you ask police if your partner has a history of violence or abuse. You can also ask about the partner of a family member or friend if you’re worried they’re at risk – and Victoria Police have to tell you."

commitment: Upgrade St Patrick’s Cathedral
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $20 million to upgrade the [St Patrick’s] cathedral to support the renewal of the St Patrick’s Cathedral Precinct."

commitment: Boost Victoria's 24 hour economy
specification:
"A Liberal and Nationals Government will implement reforms to liquor licensing, event and festival approvals, including:
• Appointing a 24 Hour Economy, Music and Events Advocate.
• Faster liquor licence approvals.
• Introducing a new Trusted Operator Status for consistently compliant venues.
• Identifying incentives for licensed venues hosting live music and performances.
• Streamlining approvals for festivals and outdoor events.
• Streamlining Place of Public Entertainment (PoPE) permits"

commitment: Establish an Affordable Ticket Scheme
specification: "Under the Greens' Affordable Ticket Scheme, major events that receive state funding or use state-funded venues would make a portion of their tickets available for $50 via a lottery open to Victorian residents."

commitment: Expand City Futures program for southeast students
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $1.2 million to help more students across the southeast join a groundbreaking program called City Futures. City Futures delivers football sessions and in-class theory around leadership, respect and personal development in school years 7 to 9."

commitment: Introduce Aidan's Law
specification: 'The Premier promised to introduce Aidan’s law by Christmas. “If you assault someone that has come in to aid someone else as a good Samaritan, that put their own life on the line, and have been violated against, that needs to be an aggravating factor in the sentencing,” Mr Carroll said.'

commitment: Recruit another 200 more police reservists
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $70 million to recruit 200 more reservists. These reservists will go straight to counters at the direction of Victoria Police, to help more stations re-open and stay open longer."

commitment: Introduce Aidan's Law
specification: "A Jess Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will introduce Aidan's Law, [...] amending Victoria's Sentencing Act to ensure courts must specifically consider whether an offender has attacked someone acting as a good Samaritan. The reform will explicitly recognise attacks on good Samaritans as an aggravating circumstance when determining a criminal sentence."

commitment: Expand The Huddle at North Melbourne Football Club
specification: "Re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $2.9 million to expand The Huddle at North Melbourne Football Club. The Huddle runs free programs to engage, support and empower young people to connect with mates, learn new skills and get ahead."

commitment: Help more women and girls get into sport
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $600,000 in the Bachar Houli Foundation, directly supporting its programs that promote women in sport."

commitment: Introduce youth rehabilitation detention
specification: "Under Labor’s plan, low and mid-level youth offenders would be sentenced to youth rehabilitation detention as part of a new Mandatory Therapeutic Order." "This is a $204 million investment and an Australian-first. It will start with almost 500 places for youth offenders over two years, and scale up."

commitment: Establish a Major Events Attraction Fund
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will establish a $40 million Major Events Attraction Fund to bring major sporting and entertainment events to Melbourne, including UFC."

commitment: Retain Infrastructure Victoria
specification: "Wilson announced on Sunday that she would not only retain Infrastructure Victoria, but broaden its remit." Jess Wilson: “We will keep Infrastructure Victoria. We will look at how we potentially strengthen their role.”

commitment: Upgrade the pavilion at Bruce Park in Frankston
specification: "A Liberal government will deliver $3 million to upgrade the pavilion at Bruce Park."

commitment: Increase bus services in Melbourne's west
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $400 million to deliver turn-up-and-go buses across Melbourne's west. A bus every 10 minutes on key routes – seven days a week." "And for the first time, there will be a direct public bus connection from Werribee to Melbourne Airport."

commitment: Crack down on illicit tobacco industry
specification:
"A Jess Wilson-led Liberals and Nationals government will introduce a range of measures to crack down on Victoria’s illicit tobacco and vape trade.
• Introduce medium-term closure powers that increase existing 90-day short-term closure power to 150 days, in line with stronger closure provisions proposed in South Australia.
• Introduce a ‘compromised goods’ seizure power allowing authorised officers to seize all tobacco and e-cigarette products where breaches are identified.
• Allow commercial landlords to terminate a tenant’s lease without compensation as soon as a short-term closure is ordered against the tenant.
• Ban ATMs at retailers found selling illicit tobacco or operating without a tobacco license.
• Make trafficking illicit tobacco a specific offence under the Coalition’s proposed Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organisations (RICO) laws."

commitment: Double carparks at West Tarneit train station
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $25 million to deliver new car parking and improved access on the north side of West Tarneit Station. Labor will deliver a new carpark with 400 spaces, bringing total carparks at West Tarneit station to 800 spaces."

commitment: Require train, tram and bus procurement to meet minimum local content target
specification: "Currently, we have a minimum local content target. A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will require every future train, tram and bus procurement to meet that target. That’s a minimum of 50 per cent local content – and we can exceed it. That’s our Make It Here Guarantee."

commitment: Expand firefighters' presumptive rights legislation
specification: "A future Liberal and Nationals Government will [...] expand presumptive rights legislation to make it consistent with other Australian jurisdictions."

commitment: Modernise Fire Rescue Victoria's ageing fleet
specification: "A future Liberal and Nationals Government will commit $160 million over four years to modernise Fire Rescue Victoria's ageing fleet, ensuring firefighters have the equipment they need to keep Victorians safe. The Liberals and Nationals will establish a rolling fleet replacement program, with $40 million allocated annually to progressively replace ageing firefighting vehicles and strengthen emergency response capabilities across Victoria. The commitment will also include an immediate review of firefighter handsets and fireground communications, and a second helmet policy and helmet replacement program."

commitment: Sell government-owned land
specification: "Opposition Leader Jess Wilson will today unveil the Coalition's plan to sell off government-owned land. 'We'll divest surplus government land and get new housing projects moving,' Wilson said. 'Our plan means more land for new homes and economic development as well as a $1.3 billion saving for the budget.' The policy would also save $266 million in interest repayments over four years, the Coalition says."

commitment: Build and upgrade TAFE campuses
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will build two new TAFE campuses in Melbourne’s outer north and west.
• In Melbourne’s west, we’ll invest $50 million in a new campus in Wyndham.
• In Melbourne’s north, we’ll invest $50 million in a new TAFE campus in the outer north near Kalkallo."
"We’re also investing $70 million to upgrade TAFE campuses across the state:
• Bendigo – $20 million to establish a Clean Economy Hub at Bendigo TAFE’s Charleston Road campus.
• Wonthaggi – $5 million for TAFE Gippsland, focused on health and construction.
• Dandenong – $45 million to build a new Home Building Centre at Chisholm’s Dandenong campus."

commitment: Invest in Victoria's medical research sector
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will help build Victoria's long-term economic future and the highly skilled jobs of tomorrow by investing $100 million in our world-leading medical research sector. Delivered over four years, our investment will support commercialisation opportunities and strengthen Victoria's position as a world leader in medical research."

commitment: Double funding for small to medium arts and screen organisations
specification: "The Greens will immediately invest an extra $90 million every year into music, theatre, visual arts, screen and other creative industries – more than doubling the grants and screen funding they currently receive."

commitment: Appoint a Land Use Commissioner
specification: "To better protect productive farmland and give farmers more of a voice in decisions affecting their land, a re-elected Carroll Labor Government will establish a Victorian Land Use Commissioner, supported by a specialist team of advisers. The Commissioner’s role will be to advise government on farmland protection and to publicly report on pressures facing the state's agricultural land."

commitment: Establish the Make It Here Fund
specification: "Labor will create a new Make It Here Fund to back Victorian businesses to make more products locally and grow their Victorian operations [and] create 5,000 more manufacturing jobs. The $350 million fund consists of $200 million for equity co-investment and $150 million for industry grants. The equity co-investment component is fully funded through remaining uncommitted capital from Innovation Victoria, formerly Breakthrough Victoria."

commitment: Support charities delivering food relief programs
specification: "Our Liberal and Nationals team has committed $2 million to support charities like Foodbank, helping them reach more families and continue their incredible work supporting Victorians who need it most."

commitment: Establish a Temple and Gurdwara Safety Fund
specification: "Victoria’s Hindu temples and Sikh gurdwaras would receive funding for safety and infrastructure upgrades under a Labor election commitment worth more than $11 million. Premier Ben Carroll announced the proposed Temple and Gurdwara Safety Fund during a visit to Sri Durga Temple on Sunday, November 1. Under the proposal, funding would support fencing, maintenance, renovation works and car parks at Hindu and Sikh places of worship. Mr Carroll said in the announcement, 'We are proud to stand with Victoria’s Indian and South Asian communities and the safety and security of their families'."

commitment: Expand opening hours for 10 existing public dental clinics
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will open 10 existing public dental clinics on weekends for emergency care." "This $26.9 million investment will support more than 50,000 Victorians."

commitment: Plan and deliver a new pedestrian crossing at Keilor Village
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3 million to plan and deliver a new pedestrian crossing at Keilor Village."

commitment: Upgrade Winchelsea Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $9.11 million to upgrade Winchelsea Primary School. That’s why Labor will deliver $8.78 million to upgrade facilities with new classrooms, open learning spaces, outdoor play spaces, and a new administration building. A further $330,000 will go towards replacing the boundary fencing along the Princes Highway, maximising student safety."

commitment: Deliver Airport Rail project as designed
specification: "Wilson said that if the Coalition government is elected, the project would continue as designed." "Pressed on whether a Coalition government would review the project in light of the allegations or consider an alternative route, Wilson said it would be built as planned. 'The route is the route. The contracts have been signed, the project is underway and the Coalition is committed to delivering airport rail.', Wilson said."

commitment: Deliver new fire trucks, better fire stations and more volunteers for the CFA
specification: "The Liberal and Nationals' $200 million plan, independently costed by the Parliamentary Budget Office, will [...] deliver 335 new CFA fire trucks over five years, 17 new and upgraded fire stations and a major recruitment drive to help keep Victorian families safe."

commitment: Upgrade the Naring Road and Tocumwal Road intersection in Numurkah
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will commit $5 million to upgrade the dangerous Numurkah/Naring/Tocumwal Road intersection." "The proposed upgrade would realign Tocumwal Road east to create two separate T-intersections on Naring Road, with protected turn lanes, concrete islands, drainage, street lighting and power pole relocation."

commitment: Deliver a comprehensive response to bird flu
specification: "The Victorian Greens will deliver a funded, coordinated response to the devastating outbreak of bird flu (H5N1) in Victoria."

commitment: Strengthen, expand and fast-track Workplace Protection Orders
specification:
"A Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will:

Protect victims immediately: Introduce interim protection orders as part of our first tranche of legislation so workers do not have to wait for a final court hearing before receiving protection.

Back our police: Allow Victoria Police to apply for protection orders on behalf of victims.

Protect more workers: Extend the scheme to all commercial, hospitality and service-based premises where workers deal with the public.

Fast-track commencement: Bring forward the scheme commencement to 1 February 2027.

Offenders who breach a Workplace Protection Order will face penalties of up to two years in prison or fines of around $50,000, with police empowered to arrest those who breach an active order."

commitment: Open 20 free public dental clinics
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will now deliver 20 free dental clinics." "Labor will deliver sign-on bonuses to bring more dentists into the public system. It’s a $5 million investment and it’s on top of our existing workforce attraction package including relocation support and clinical scholarships." [From earlier media release:] "Labor is investing an additional $12.9 million to grow and retain a strong workforce across the clinics."

commitment: Establish a new public radiation therapy facility in Werribee
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will establish a new public radiation therapy facility in Werribee." "The new $24.4 million facility will provide free public radiation therapy services."

commitment: Upgrade 50 local roads
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will upgrade 50 local roads." "In total, these 50 upgrades represent a $3.6 billion investment in upgrading our road network."

commitment: Support Hampton Park Uniting Church's food relief and community support programs
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $100,000 to support food relief and community support programs delivered by the Hampton Park Uniting Church."

commitment: Build Stage 1 of the Bellarine Link
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will get Geelong and the Surf Coast Region moving by delivering Bellarine Link (Stage 1). A Liberal and Nationals Government will build a new four lane arterial road the entire distance between Surf Coast Highway (Torquay Road) and Barwon Heads Road [and] include cycle and pedestrian paths, upgrade intersections where required, and provide quicker and safer connections across the region. This project has been costed by the independent Parliamentary Budget Office at $335.1 million."

commitment: Make the Birrarung Yarra swimmable by 2036
specification: "The Victorian Greens have today announced an ambitious plan to clean up the Birrarung Yarra and make it safe to swim in by 2036, backed by $70 million in initial investment to restore the river and its surrounding ecosystems."

commitment: Install new Keep Clear zone markings at intersections in Reservoir
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $150,000 to install Keep Clear zone markings at the Broadway, Marchant Avenue and Bernard Street intersections in Reservoir."

commitment: Strip Ambulance Victoria membership from patients who abuse or threaten ambulance workers
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will impose more consequences for patients who abuse or threaten ambulance workers. Under Labor’s plan, violent and abusive patients will also be stripped of their Ambulance Victoria membership – so they lose cover for ambulance costs."

commitment: Upgrade Clarinda Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3.26 million to support upgrades at Clarinda Primary School. This upgrade will deliver a masterplan and upgrades at the school, including Block B."

commitment: Deliver an expanded bushfire detection camera network
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will also invest $2.52 million over four years, alongside industry co-investment, to deliver an expanded $4.41 million bushfire detection camera network across 18 locations in eastern and western Victoria."

commitment: Duplicate Dyson Drive between Remembrance Drive and Ballarat-Carngham Road
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will get Ballarat's growing suburbs moving by duplicating Dyson Drive between Remembrance Drive and Ballarat-Carngham Road. The project will duplicate Dyson Drive from its current two lanes to four, and deliver intersection upgrades." "This project will cost $115.1 million."

commitment: Establish a new Forest Management Program
specification:
"A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will protect healthy forests and restore degraded ones through our Forest Management Program. The Program will:
• Double planned burning and expand cultural burning in partnership with Indigenous Victorians
• Reduce fuel loads
• Build and maintain a statewide firebreak network
• Control invasive pests and weeds
• Put more rangers on the ground
• Deliver increased public reporting every year on biodiversity and ecological outcomes."

commitment: Maintain the Victorian Racing Industry Fund
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals will commit $72 million to continue the Victorian Racing Industry Fund [and] maintain funding for vital capital works across all three racing codes."

commitment: Free up hospital beds
specification: "The Greens will invest in more staffed hospital beds, as well as more rehabilitation and aged care beds, so patients who no longer need acute care can free up hospital beds."

commitment: Support the hospital workforce
specification: "The Greens will support the hospital workforce with better pay and conditions and more allied health workers, and by establishing a Victorian Taskforce on Occupational Violence in Healthcare."

commitment: Expand Workplace Protection Orders scheme to hospitals
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will expand our Workplace Protection Orders scheme to hospitals."

commitment: Make hospitals safer places to work
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will deliver $30 million for practical ways to make hospitals safer. Hospitals will be able to apply for grants to fund:
• Better lighting across hospital grounds
• More CCTV to deter violence and abuse
• Duress alarms so staff can call for help
• Secure areas to protect frontline workers
• Locks and barriers to restrict access to staff-only areas
• Safe retreat areas where workers can seek protection"

commitment: Upgrade Wendouree Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $6.22 million to support upgrades at Wendouree Primary School. This upgrade will deliver new facilities replacing Block C and Block E."

commitment: Waive stamp duty for businesses transitioning from discretionary trusts
specification: "Labor will legislate to waive stamp duty for businesses transitioning from discretionary trusts, due to Commonwealth tax changes. A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will provide a three-year stamp duty moratorium for eligible discretionary trusts that restructure into alternate arrangements. Eligibility will be based on those entities that qualify for the Commonwealth’s rollover relief."

commitment: Upgrade the Western Freeway
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will deliver the upgrade of the Western Freeway." "A Liberal and Nationals Government will deliver 30 kilometres of new lanes and upgrades to key interchanges." "This project will cost $550 million, alongside $1 billion in Commonwealth funding."

commitment: Ban owners corporation managers from taking kickbacks
specification: "New laws will ban owners corporation managers from taking commissions or payments that influence what they buy. Brokers' commissions will be examined too. We will also set up a dedicated Owners Corporations Taskforce inside Consumer Affairs Victoria, with the powers to monitor and enforce the new rules. Owners will also get a fairer say at their AGM."

commitment: Bring public school cleaning services in-house
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will bring public school cleaning services in-house. Cleaners will be employed directly by the Department of Education and will be part of the local school workforce."

commitment: Hire more graduate nurses and midwives and train more nurse prescribers
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will subsidise 300 graduate nurse and midwifery places in health services across Victoria. That’s a $132 million investment over four years." "Labor will also train nurses to prescribe medication, making it easier for patients. A $1.7 million investment over four years will fund 200 training scholarships."

commitment: Upgrade facilities at Westmeadows War Memorial
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $200,000 to deliver paving, seating, planting and lighting upgrades at the Westmeadows War Memorial."

commitment: Expand bans on speech that amounts to incitement to violence
specification: "Jess Wilson has vowed to expand bans on pro-Palestinian slogans that incite violence, including the phrase 'globalise the intifada', if elected." "Under my leadership, we will expand bans on speech that amounts to incitement to violence, like ‘Globalise the intifada’." "Ms Wilson also promised to [...] review and withdraw taxpayer funding from organisations that promoted hatred or incited violence." "Not one cent of taxpayer money should go to organisations that promote antisemitism or extremism," she said.

commitment: Fund local transport
specification: "The Greens will create a $3 billion Local Transport and Initiative Fund, to fund our local transport projects, as well as other local initiatives. This will be a seed fund within the general government sector."

commitment: Replace ageing fire trucks
specification: "The Greens will invest $200 million now, to replace ageing trucks, as well as legislating to ensure fire trucks are replaced regularly into the future."

commitment: Slash emergency department wait times
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will slash ED wait times by expanding 12 hospital emergency departments by 25 per cent, by:
• hiring 1500 health workers – including 750 more nurses
• delivering 250 more beds – about the size of a hospital."
"It’s a $1.5 billion investment in public hospitals."

commitment: Upgrade Carrum Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3.24 million to upgrade Carrum Primary School. That’s why Labor will deliver new classrooms and upgraded outdoor learning areas, completing the school’s modernisation."

commitment: Upgrade Eltham North Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $24.74 million to upgrade Eltham North Primary School. That’s why Labor will deliver a new administration block and gymnasium, including library, music and canteen spaces."

commitment: Upgrade Kilberry Valley Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $7.94 million to upgrade Kilberry Valley Primary School. That’s why Labor will deliver major upgrades – including support for the school’s STEM program."

commitment: Upgrade the pavilion at Laurimar Reserve in Doreen
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $6 million to help upgrade the pavilion at Laurimar Reserve, Doreen."

commitment: Sell the Melbourne Wholesale Fruit and Vegetable Market
specification: "Divesting ownership of the Melbourne Wholesale Fruit and Vegetable Market and winding-up the Melbourne Market Authority (MMA) will reduce Victoria’s net debt by $578 million."

commitment: Plan traffic signals at Johnstone Street and Broadmeadows Road intersection in Westmeadows
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3 million to plan for traffic signals at the Johnstone Street and Broadmeadows Road intersection."

commitment: Build 25,600 homes for first home buyers
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will build 25,600 new homes and reserve them for first home buyers." "Labor will partner with the Commonwealth to deliver 25,600 new homes for first home buyers in more than 20 locations across Victoria."

commitment: Extend the adult ban on smart glasses to non-government schools
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will extend the adult ban on smart glasses to non-government schools, which will be done through legislation."

commitment: Plan traffic signals at Mickleham Road and Broadmeadows Road roundabout in Westmeadows
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $2.5 million to plan for traffic signals at the Mickleham Road and Broadmeadows Road roundabout in Westmeadows."

commitment: Expand the Urgent Care Pathways initiative
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberals and Nationals Government will invest $52 million to expand the Urgent Care Pathways initiative as part of Our Plan to Deliver for Victorians, giving more Aboriginal Victorians access to vital healthcare closer to home. The four-year investment will renew funding for 11 existing Aboriginal Community Controlled Organisations and expand the program to an additional five organisations across Victoria."

commitment: Give the Victorian Men's Shed Association a say in decisions about Men's Sheds
specification: "An elected Liberal and Nationals Government will give the Victorian Men's Shed Association (VMSA) a formal seat at the table to help shape how Men's Sheds are funded, deliver vital services and plan for the future, at no extra cost to taxpayers."

commitment: Legislate a climate change Duty of Care
specification: "Candidates standing in the November Victorian election have pledged to legislate a Duty of Care that would hold the next state government legally accountable for climate harm inflicted on children and future generations. So far, 98 candidates across the political spectrum have signed the Pollies’ Pledge, including [...] Greens MPs Ellen Sandell ..."

commitment: Cap public transport fares at $30 a week
specification: "Labor will cap public transport fares at $30 a week." "Concession holders save, too – their fares will be capped at $15 a week." "It will start Jan 1 when half-price fares are scheduled to end – and run for two years." "This two-year cost-of-living commitment will cost $206 million."

commitment: Upgrade parks across Sydenham district
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $1 million to deliver upgrades to local parks across Sydenham [...] at Keilor Lodge Reserve on Tasman Crescent, Orchid Square in Sydenham, Emerald Park playground in Delahey and Stagecoach in Sydenham."

commitment: Upgrade sports facilities at Copperfield College’s Sydenham campus
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $19.1 million to upgrade Copperfield College’s Sydenham campus [...] including a synthetic basketball court and soccer pitch."

commitment: Return passenger train services to Mildura and Dimboola
specification: "Under the $51.2 million Wimmera Mallee Rail Plan, passenger services will return to Mildura and Dimboola by mid-2029, giving regional Victorians more choice in how they travel. The initial investment will fund infrastructure improvements, potential train acquisition and refurbishment, and operating costs over four years."

commitment: Cap tolls at $30 a week
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will cap tolls at $30 a week in 2027." "This one-year cost-of-living commitment will cost $191 million." "We’ll also scrap the need for expensive paper administration fees for missing eTags. A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will change the law, so you can be notified electronically."

commitment: Support construction of an undercover riding arena at the RDA in Pakenham
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $250,000 to support an undercover riding arena at Riding for the Disabled Association (RDA) Pakenham." "Labor will back the local council and deliver up to $250,000 towards an undercover riding arena, supporting accessibility and enabling all-weather riding lessons and therapy."

commitment: Upgrade pavilion and change rooms at Coventry Oval in Diamond Creek
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3 million to support a refurbished pavilion and away change rooms at Coventry Oval, Diamond Creek."

commitment: Improve bushfire preparedness
specification:
"The Liberals and The Nationals will double prescribed burning and work towards the Bushfire Royal Commission's recommendation to treat 5 per cent of treatable public land annually." "The plan will also:
• Expand cultural burning in partnership with Indigenous Victorians, combining traditional knowledge with modern fire management to reduce bushfire risk and care for Country.
• Put more boots on the ground and less bureaucracy in Melbourne, backing the people who know the land, forests and fire risks.
• Restore transparency by publishing fuel management plans, targets and results, so communities can see what is promised and what is delivered."

commitment: Make recreational prospecting and fossicking free
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will make recreational prospecting and fossicking free from next year, helping more families get outdoors and try their luck."

commitment: Upgrade Mandurang CFA
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3.95 million to deliver a larger station for Mandurang CFA."

commitment: Commission an independent review into Victoria's child protection system
specification: "Victoria's child protection system is under enormous pressure [...] A Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will immediately commission an independent review focused on delivering wholesale reform, including examining why previous recommendations have not been implemented and how they can finally be put into practice."

commitment: Upgrade the Urgent Care Centre at Daylesford Hospital
specification: "A Jess Wilson Liberal Government will commit $12 million for necessary upgrades to the Urgent Care Centre at Daylesford Hospital."

commitment: Build a Park and Ride facility near Casey Fields
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $15.89 million to deliver a Park and Ride facility near Casey Fields."

commitment: Create more shade and green space in Carrum Downs
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $200,000 to deliver more shade and green space for locals in Carrum Downs. Labor’s investment will deliver tree-lined boulevards, an urban forest and pocket parks."

commitment: Increase staff and student representation on university councils and enhance university governance
specification: "The government will change the law to increase the minimum number of elected staff and student representatives on university councils to at least two staff and two students." "In the next term, the Government will introduce legislation into Parliament to amend the university enabling Acts. Additionally, Victoria encourages universities to adopt a proactive approach to elevate staff and student voices."

commitment: Make abortion free and extend access
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will eliminate out-of-pocket costs for abortions across Victoria." "Labor will standardise care across Victoria and extend the window for medical abortion to 10 weeks gestation. [...] Safer Care Victoria will also lead a clinical review into extending access to MTOP up to 12 weeks gestation." "We will deliver training for nurse practitioners and endorsed midwives working in community health care who want to provide abortion care." "Labor will also expand its 1800 My Options service delivered by Women’s Health Victoria."

commitment: Upgrade Goddard Street Reserve in Tarneit
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $250,000 to upgrade Goddard Street Reserve in Tarneit." "Labor will back the local council and deliver up to $250,000 towards a new elevated coaches box."

commitment: Upgrade Maiden Gully Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $7.9 million to upgrade Maiden Gully Primary School. Labor will deliver Stage 2 of the upgrade, including a new general learning building."

commitment: Cover out-of-pocket costs for abortion care
specification: "Opposition Leader Jess Wilson on Thursday backed a plan to remove out-of-pocket costs for abortion care, just hours it was unveiled by the Victorian government. Ms Wilson said an elected coalition government would match Labor's commitment to cover out-pocket-costs for abortion care up to 16 weeks' gestation. "The Liberals and Nationals will not allow Labor to play politics on this issue," she said in a statement supplied to AAP."

commitment: Bring Preston Market into public ownership
specification: "The Greens are calling for the state and federal governments to work with Darebin Council to acquire the [Preston Market] site and establish a public market model with a formal role for traders and the local community."

commitment: Implement a seven-point plan for a better Docklands
specification: "Docklands should have beautiful green spaces, thriving local shops, safe walking and cycling routes, and the schools and community facilities a growing suburb needs. That’s why I’ve released my seven-point plan for a better Docklands."

commitment: Establish a Growth Area Entrepreneur Club for small businesses in Melbourne’s north
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $100,000 to deliver small business training and networking support in Melbourne’s northern suburbs. Labor’s plan for a Growth Area Entrepreneur Club means more small business owners will have the skills and support to successfully run their own business."

commitment: Establish an antimony processing facility
specification: "Labor will invest $20 million towards Australia’s first antimony processing facility […] right here in Northern Victoria."

commitment: Review property charges
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will review the Absentee Owner Surcharge and Foreign Purchaser Additional Duty." "Labor will also establish a comprehensive review to investigate the effectiveness and impact of property charges. The review will investigate:
• whether revenue is collected efficiently
• how it is impacting foreign investment in construction
• the impacts on first home buyers."

commitment: Expand the Victorian Patient Transport Assistance Scheme
specification: "A $53.6 million investment will expand the Victorian Patient Transport Assistance Scheme (VPTAS)." "The fuel reimbursement will jump from 21 cents per kilometre to 35 cents per kilometre. Victoria will also move to a flat rate accommodation subsidy of $125 per night. This is an increase of $80 per night."

commitment: Support expansion of the Victorian Indigenous Nursery Co-Op
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $2 million to expand production capacity at the Victorian Indigenous Nursery Co-Op."

commitment: Upgrade Strathmore Secondary College
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $10 million to upgrade Strathmore Secondary College. That’s why Labor will deliver stage 3 of the rebuild masterplan, including completing the Learning Centre."

commitment: Upgrade the rugby field at Narre Warren South P-12 College
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $530,000 to upgrade the rugby field at Narre Warren South P-12 College [to] support Academy Movement’s youth programs."

commitment: Build a roundabout at intersection of Murray Valley and Kiewa Valley Highways near Wodonga
specification:
"The Victorian Liberals have pledged $20 million to build a roundabout at the Murray Valley Highway and Kiewa Valley Highway intersection near Wodonga if elected in November.
Victorian Liberal Leader Jess Wilson has also backed the commitment. "Steve Martin has been a strong advocate for fixing this dangerous intersection, and with him on our Liberal team, we will deliver it," Ms Wilson said."

commitment: Cover half the off-the-job training costs for apprentices
specification: "Under our team's plan, a new Accelerating Apprenticeships Fund will cover half the off-the-job training costs per apprentice [...] Businesses employing apprentices in occupations on the Australian Apprenticeships Priority List will be eligible to claim quarterly rebates for approved training costs. [...] The Accelerating Apprenticeship Fund will cost $115 million."

commitment: Redevelop the pavilion and club rooms at Orrong Romanis Reserve in Prahran
specification: "A Wilson Coalition Government will commit $6 million towards the delivery of a new pavilion and club rooms at the Orrong Romanis Reserve in Prahran."

commitment: Establish Royalties for the Regions
specification: "That’s why a re-elected Carroll Labor Government will establish Royalties for the Regions. It guarantees every cent that Victoria collects in resource royalties gets invested back into regional Victoria."

commitment: Introduce a buffer between waste-to-energy projects and homes
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will introduce a 2-kilometre buffer between new waste-to-energy project boundaries and existing homes."

commitment: Establish 10 new technical colleges
specification: "Under our plan, 10 new Technical Colleges will be established across Victoria, giving 5,000 secondary students hands-on vocational education and training." "These new Technical Colleges will cost $222 million over eight years."

commitment: Modernise and expand Eltham Men’s Shed
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $100,000 to modernise and expand the Eltham Men’s Shed."

commitment: Redevelop two netball courts at Mossfiel Reserve in Hoppers Crossing
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $700,000 to support the redevelopment of two [netball] courts at Mossfiel Reserve in Hoppers Crossing."

commitment: Contribute $20 million towards building a new indoor basketball and netball facility at Essendon Fields
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal Government will contribute $20 million towards the construction of a new indoor basketball and netball facility at Essendon Fields."

commitment: Build a new pavilion at Canning Reserve in Avondale Heights
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3 million to support a new pavilion at Canning Reserve, Avondale Heights."

commitment: Upgrade Buckley Park Bowls Club
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $5 million to upgrade the Buckley Park Bowls Club with a new bowls facility. Our investment will bring together the Buckley Park, Essendon and Maribyrnong Park bowls clubs."

commitment: Upgrade Dandenong Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $6.41 million to upgrade Dandenong Primary School." "Labor’s investment will upgrade Building A and replace a relocatable classroom building that’s in a poor condition."

commitment: Upgrade St Albans North Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $9.18 million to upgrade St Albans North Primary School. Labor’s upgrade will deliver stage 1 of the masterplan, including a new learning and library facility."

commitment: Upgrade Viewbank College
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $26.77 million for a major upgrade at Viewbank College. Labor’s upgrade will deliver a new gymnasium and expanded permanent classrooms."

commitment: Develop a business case for redeveloping Market Square Quarter in Central Geelong
specification: "A Jess Wilson Liberal government will also bring Market Square back to life, by providing funding to the City of Greater Geelong to develop a comprehensive business case for the redevelopment of the Market Square Quarter in Central Geelong. The business case, developed in partnership with the Victorian Planning Authority, will assess the options for redeveloping Market Square and determine the costs, benefits, and jobs the project would deliver."

commitment: Move the Moorabool Street bus interchange from the Geelong CBD
specification: "[A Jess Wilson led government] will commit $800,000 to remove the Moorabool Street bus interchange from the CBD and relocate services to existing facilities at Geelong Station. This money will help to decommission the interchange and restore the streetscape, and support a free Council-run City Circle shuttle to ensure there is no disruption to the service."

commitment: Deliver 150 new fire trucks
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will keep Victorians safe with 150 new fire trucks for the frontline." "We will deliver 150 new fire trucks by 2030. Labor’s $167 million investment means:
• 50 new FRV trucks
• 50 new CFA pumpers and pumper-tankers
• 50 new CFA tankers"
"Labor also commits that by 2035, no FRV truck is operating beyond its service life of 15 years. And we’ll replace all single-cab CFA tankers. We’ll do it by manufacturing them right here in Victoria."

commitment: Extend Langwarrin Men’s Shed
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $100,000 to extend the Langwarrin Men’s Shed."

commitment: Rebuild the pavilion at Kelynack Reserve in Mill Park
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $5 million to help rebuild the pavilion at Kelynack Reserve in Mill Park."

commitment: Upgrade Hillsview Recreation Reserve in South Morang
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $250,000 to help deliver upgrades at Hillsview Recreation Reserve, South Morang."

commitment: Bring Proton Beam therapy to Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre
specification: "We will help bring Proton Beam therapy to Peter Mac right here in Victoria, giving children and adults with complex cancers access to world class treatment closer to home."

commitment: Build a new pedestrian crossing across Nepean Highway in Chelsea
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $5 million to deliver a new pedestrian crossing across Nepean Highway in Chelsea."

commitment: Build stage 2 of the Spotswood Primary School masterplan
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $4 million to deliver stage 2 of the Spotswood Primary School masterplan. The funding will deliver a new gym, music building, and canteen building, and give students modern, purpose-built spaces to learn, play and create."

commitment: Put more social services organisations on four-year funding agreements
specification: "I know that most organisations in the sector operate on yearly applications for funding. [...] If re-elected, Labor will change the funding arrangements. I want to get as many social services organisations as possible on four-year funding agreements – rather than one-year agreements."

commitment: Support the community legal sector
specification: "The Attorney-General today announced an immediate $28.5 million investment into the community legal sector through the Victorian Legal Services Board grants program."

commitment: Upgrade Dalyston Recreation Reserve with a new scoreboard and solar
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $120,000 to support a new scoreboard and solar conversion of the clubrooms at Dalyston Recreation Reserve, Dalyston."

commitment: Upgrade HE Parker Reserve in Heathmont with ball-catch nets and a new scoreboard
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $150,000 to upgrade HE Parker Reserve in Heathmont." "Labor will back the local council and deliver up to $100,000 for ball-catch nets behind the goals, as well as $50,000 for a new scoreboard."

commitment: Upgrade the hard court at Keilor Views Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $410,000 to upgrade facilities at Keilor Views Primary School." "Labor will upgrade the hard court at the school."

commitment: Build Stage 2 of the Goulburn Valley Health Integrated Cancer Centre
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will invest $95 million to deliver Stage 2 of the Goulburn Valley Health Integrated Cancer Centre."

commitment: Invest $1 billion into community safety
specification: "The Greens will invest $1 billion into community safety. We will establish a new Office of Community Safety and Crime Prevention. We will invest in a statewide mental health outreach and crisis response. And we’ll address the root causes of crime by investing in mental health, addiction services, homelessness support, housing, youth and family services."

commitment: Trial publicly-owned supermarkets
specification: "The Greens will open 10 publicly-owned local supermarkets." "We’ll invest $350m over the next four years as an initial investment in this nation-first trial and in giving farmers a fair deal and caps on supermarket price gouging." "We’ll [empower] the Essential Services Commission to set minimum farm-gate prices on essentials [and] set maximum prices for key essential grocery items."

commitment: Evaluate medicinal cannabis to treat veteran and first responder work-related injuries
specification: "The action I seek is for the minister to support a government-funded evaluation of medicinal cannabis as a treatment option for veterans and first responders who have sustained work related injuries, including post-traumatic stress disorder and chronic pain. Pharmaceuticals such as antidepressants and benzodiazepines are currently the first line of treatment for PTSD."

commitment: Redevelop Somerville Recreation Reserve
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $5 million to support a new pavilion and redeveloped grounds at Somerville Recreation Reserve."

commitment: Support Wildlife Victoria’s travelling vet response service
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $900,000 to support Wildlife Victoria’s travelling vet response service, based in Nunawading."

commitment: Upgrade buildings at Cockatoo Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $14.37 million to support upgrades at Cockatoo Primary School. This upgrade will deliver modernised buildings, including a new learning base facility and a refurbished Building D and library."

commitment: Upgrade Greenvale Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $10.76 million to support upgrades at Greenvale Primary School. This upgrade will deliver a new administration and resource intensive learning building."

commitment: Upgrade Hoppers Crossing CFA
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $30,000 to upgrade Hoppers Crossing CFA [with] a new surveillance and security system and minor upgrades."

commitment: Upgrade Ivanhoe Sporting Precinct
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $1 million to improve Ivanhoe Sporting Precinct, spanning Ivanhoe Recreation Reserve, Ivanhoe Park and Chelsworth Park, with improved community facilities and services."

commitment: Upgrade Sunshine North Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $1.9 million to begin upgrades at Sunshine North Primary School."

commitment: Masterplan a new standalone youth mental health facility in Parkville
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will also invest $5 million to masterplan a new standalone youth mental health facility at Parkville, completing planning, clinical service design and detailed costings by June 2030."

commitment: Open a new Youth Mental Health Centre of Excellence
specification: "At the heart of the youth mental health commitment will be a new Youth Mental Health Centre of Excellence, overseen by leading youth mental health organisation Orygen."

commitment: Redevelop Somerville Recreation Reserve
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal Government will invest $6 million to help deliver the full redevelopment of the Somerville Recreation Reserve. The redevelopment will deliver a rebuild of the reserve’s social rooms, grandstand, dedicated female change rooms, public toilets, first aid and administration rooms, additional storage, sealed car parking and the reconfiguration of the netball courts."

commitment: Reset Victoria's mental health system
specification:
"A Liberal and Nationals Government will deliver sweeping reforms to reset Victoria's mental health system. The sweeping reforms will:
• Independently review implementation of the Royal Commission recommendations.
• Audit mental health reform expenditure and the Mental Health and Wellbeing Levy.
• Deliver a new Mental Health Workforce Strategy within 100 days, backed by a $50 million Targeted Mental Health Workforce Fund.
• Review the Mental Health and Wellbeing Commission to strengthen its independence, powers and system-wide oversight.
• Publish a Mental Health Reform Blueprint with clear priorities, responsibilities, timeframes, funding and measurable outcomes.
• Reform the governance of the Parkville Youth Mental Health and Wellbeing Service (PYMHWS) and integrate its management with Orygen."

commitment: Plan future upgrades at Edithvale Primary School
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will deliver $500,000 to kickstart planning for future upgrades at Edithvale Primary School."

commitment: Turn Keilor Downs College's gymnasium into a new performing arts centre
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $10.73 million to support a new performing arts centre at Keilor Downs College. Labor’s major upgrade will turn the existing gymnasium into a performing arts centre."

commitment: Upgrade main building block at The Grange P-12 College in Hoppers Crossing
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $19.74 million to upgrade The Grange P-12 College. The project will upgrade and modernise the school’s main building block."

commitment: Open up to 10 new or expanded patient transit lounges
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will get patients treated in emergency departments sooner under a new commitment to deliver up to 10 new or expanded patient transit lounges across Victorian hospitals." "To deliver the expansion, a Liberal and Nationals Government will establish a $99 million Patient Transit Lounge Fund."

commitment: Consolidate government car fleet
specification: "We will create capacity by consolidating the government car fleet, saving $70 million."

commitment: Cut land tax
specification: "We will reverse the 2023 changes to the land tax threshold. We will implement it progressively." "Labor’s land tax changes will cost $230 million over five years."

commitment: Upgrade media facilities at Springside Recreation Reserve in Caroline Springs
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $200,000 to deliver a new media box at Springside Recreation Reserve, Caroline Springs."

commitment: Establish SurgerySooner program to deliver public patient elective surgeries at private hospitals
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will establish SurgerySooner to halve Victoria's elective surgery waitlist by giving public patients the choice to undergo their surgery at a private hospital at no cost."

commitment: Build a new ambulance branch in Smythesdale
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $7.1 million to deliver a new ambulance branch in Smythesdale."

commitment: Redevelop Alphington Bowls Club pavilion
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $1.85 million to redevelop the pavilion at the Alphington Bowls Club [...] with new bathrooms, amenity improvements and better spaces for all."

commitment: Build a new indoor basketball and netball court facility in Essendon Fields
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $15 million to deliver new basketball and netball courts at Essendon Fields."

commitment: Plan upgrades at Keilor Road–Hoffmans Road intersection and along Keilor Park Drive
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $1 million to kickstart an upgrade at intersection of Keilor Road and Hoffmans Road, and along Keilor Park Drive. The planning work will focus on how to improve safety for all road users, help pedestrians and cyclists move around, and support local businesses."

commitment: Build a new fire station for Keysborough Fire Brigade
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $10 million to build a new fire station for Keysborough Fire Brigade."

commitment: Deliver a Youth Hub in the City of Whittlesea
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $2.2 million to deliver a dedicated Youth Hub for the City of Whittlesea."

commitment: Redevelop the pavilion in Ligar Street Reserve in Clunes
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $5 million to redevelop the pavilion at Ligar Street Reserve in Clunes."

commitment: Renew and increase the Victorian Racing Industry Fund
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will renew and increase the Victorian Racing Industry Fund." "An $80 million investment will help grow the sport and support grassroots racing across Victoria. This is an [$8m] increase on the previous $72 million commitment for the VRIF."

commitment: Upgrade pavilion and ground at Edithvale Common
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $2.5 million to support upgrades to the pavilion and ground at Edithvale Common, Edithvale."

commitment: Build a new SES unit for Maryborough
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $9.79 million to secure land and build a new SES unit for Maryborough."

commitment: Build Melbourne Airport Rail Stage 2 including new train station in Keilor East
specification: "The Albanese and Carroll Labor Governments are getting on with building Melbourne Airport Rail Stage 2, with work set to begin in the coming weeks. It will include a new 7.4-kilometre rail line from Albion toward the Airport precinct via a brand-new Keilor East station, as part of the $12 billion joint commitment from the Albanese and Carroll Labor Governments."

commitment: Upgrade Skipton Recreation Reserve in Skipton with new changerooms
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $2.35 million to deliver new changerooms at Skipton Recreation Reserve, Skipton."

commitment: Reclassify feral deer as a pest, instead of a protected species
specification: "We'll also address immediate threats to our threatened species – we’ll reclassify feral deer as a pest, instead of a protected species [...]"

commitment: Remediate main building at Old Beaufort School site and reopen it for community use
specification: "Labor will back Stage 2 of the redevelopment [of the Old Beaufort Primary School Site], delivering $3.69 million to reopen the main school building for community use – building on the $800,000 already delivered by Labor for the masterplan and early works."

commitment: Upgrade local roads across the Dandenong Ranges
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $5 million in better local roads across the Dandenong Ranges." "Labor will partner with local councils to co-fund the sealing of local connector roads, creating safer alternative routes for locals and visitors."

commitment: Redevelop Nunawading Basketball Centre into new Nunawading Indoor Sports Centre
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal Government will deliver $25 million towards the redevelopment of the Nunawading Basketball Centre into a new Nunawading Indoor Sports Centre."

commitment: Start the duplication of the Upfield line and delay level crossing removals
specification: "We will invest $80 million over the next two years to kickstart the duplication of the Upfield Line [between Gowrie and Upfield stations]." "By delaying the removal of eight level crossings on the Upfield Line, we will save the Budget $686 million."

commitment: Enable victims of climate disasters to sue major emitters of greenhouse gases
specification: "The Greens have introduced laws in Victoria to make coal and gas companies legally liable for their share of damage from the climate crisis, granting victims of extreme bushfires, heatwaves and storms the right to sue for financial damages and even force polluting facilities to reduce emissions or shut down entirely."

commitment: Upgrade Jubilee Park in Ringwood
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $200,000 to support upgrades at Jubilee Park, Ringwood. Labor will back the local council to deliver $100,000 for new spectator seating as well as $100,000 for new ball catch nets behind the goals."

commitment: Upgrade Keilor Park Recreation Reserve
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $200,000 to support lighting and amenities upgrades at Keilor Park Recreation Reserve, Keilor Park."

commitment: Abolish Emergency Management Days for prisoners
specification: "Victorian prisoners will no longer receive sentence discounts via Emergency Management Days (EMDs) under a Liberal and Nationals Government."

commitment: Build two new netball courts at Walker Park in Nunawading
specification: "A Wilson State Liberal Government will support local netball and sport with $2m to build two new competition grade dedicated netball courts at Walker Park, with lights and a roof."

commitment: Introduce Right to Ask, Right to Know (Clare's Law) disclosure scheme
specification: "We will introduce 'Right to Ask, Right to Know' laws, creating a mechanism that allows people to find out if their partner has a known history of domestic abuse."

commitment: Change rules for pubs and local venues
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will change the rules for pubs. Under Labor, every pub in Victoria will have the automatic right to trade to 3am. Labor will amend the Food Act 1984 to overturn the ban of dogs inside pubs. Labor will cut red tape for pubs to get business moving."

commitment: Donate $500,000 to My Room Children’s Cancer Charity
specification: "The Carroll Labor Government will make a $500,000 donation for My Room Children’s Cancer Charity (My Room) on behalf of all Victorians."

commitment: Fund new ultrasound equipment and training for Sexual and Reproductive Health Hubs
specification: "Minister for Health Ingrid Stitt today announced the roll out of new ultrasound equipment at Victoria’s 20 Sexual and Reproductive Health Hubs." "The equipment and clinician training are backed by a $480,000 Carroll Labor Government investment."

commitment: Review Victoria's foster and kinship care system and create a new Carer and Volunteer Workforce Strategy
specification: "A Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will put foster and kinship carers' voices back at the centre of Victoria's child protection system, with an independent review and a new Carer and Volunteer Workforce Strategy to rebuild a system under enormous pressure."

commitment: Support local live music
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will protect local live music by:
• creating live music precincts that shift the balance away from noise objectors
• simplifying rules and red tape for permits and noise
• stepping in to help, with more gigs and mandated local music in advertising."

commitment: Introduce Jack’s Law
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals have a plan to reduce crime and will introduce Jack's Law within our first 100 days of government." "The laws would give police the power to stop and scan people using technology that detects knives, helping get dangerous weapons off our streets."

commitment: End subsidies and tax exemptions for fossil fuel projects
specification: "Ending subsidies and tax exemptions for fossil fuel projects, so that money can be spent on our communities."

commitment: Ensure Yallourn’s four coal-burning units close as planned in 2028
specification: "Ensure Yallourn’s four coal-burning units close as planned in 2028, and invest in renewables to enable individual units at Loy Yang A to be switched off earlier than planned, before its scheduled closure in 2035."

commitment: Establish a $1 billion climate adaptation and mitigation seed fund
specification: "Establish a $1 billion climate adaptation and mitigation seed fund, for communities impacted by climate disasters."

commitment: Fast-track planning approvals for wind farms and transmission lines
specification: "Get more renewable energy online faster by fast-tracking planning approvals for wind farms and transmission lines."

commitment: Fully implement the recommendations of the Yoorrook Commission
specification: "The Greens will implement all [recommendations of the Yoorrook Commission], starting with an initial investment of $50 million."

commitment: Invest in publicly-owned renewables and establish a public energy retailer
specification: "Invest in a big build of publicly-owned renewables, investing $2 billion extra into the State Electricity Commission to put publicly-owned solar on schools, public housing and government buildings so savings go back to Victorians, not corporate shareholders. Establish a public energy retailer within the State Electricity Commission, so ordinary Victorians can access cheaper energy."

commitment: Make AI data centre companies compensate affected residents
specification: "The Greens will make data centre companies compensate residents already affected by existing facilities, including for noise, pollution and any loss of value to their properties."

commitment: Make big polluters fund climate disaster clean-up
specification: "Make big polluting corporations fund clean-up for communities hit by climate disasters, and legislate to make gas companies pay to clean up the mess they leave behind in our oceans."

commitment: Provide more funding for neighbourhood houses
specification: ""Victoria's Neighbourhood Houses will receive a $10 million funding boost under a Liberal and Nationals Government." "This rolling commitment over four years will extend to Neighbourhood Houses that currently receive no state funding, while providing additional and recurring funding to support existing neighbourhood houses across Victoria. A new $6 million growth fund will be established to help Neighbourhood Houses establish or grow in some of Victoria's fastest growing areas."

commitment: Halt approvals of new AI data centres
specification: "Legalise Cannabis Victoria MP David Ettershank has called for an immediate moratorium on data centre approvals."

commitment: Redevelop cohealth Collingwood
specification: "Minister for Housing Nick Staikos and Minister for Health Ingrid Stitt have today announced Labor will redevelop the Hoddle Street site." "cohealth will own the ground floor, where its health services will be delivered. The redevelopment will also deliver 69 new social homes."

commitment: Support breweries, festivals and live music in regional Victoria
specification: "Labor will start a [$3 million] Regional Brewery Fund." "Labor will deliver a $2 million Protecting Regional Festivals Fund." "Labor will create regional touring grants to keep the acts coming. The $4 million grants will directly support local promoters."

commitment: Contribute an additional $100 million to upgrade Albury Hospital
specification: "The New South Wales, Victorian and Commonwealth Governments are progressing a jointly funded $558 million redevelopment of the Albury Hospital campus of Albury Wodonga Health." "To ensure this redevelopment meets the long-term healthcare needs of the region, a Jess Wilson-led government will deliver an additional $100 million towards this project."

commitment: Conduct an inquiry into bringing road maintenance and VicRoads back into public hands
specification: "The Greens will bring road maintenance back into public hands. We will reinvest any savings into actually fixing potholes and our roads, cutting out corporate profit. WA has done it, Victoria can do the same by first establishing an urgent inquiry to provide a clear roadmap for bringing both road maintenance and VicRoads back into public hands."

commitment: Introduce tougher penalties for rapists and sex offenders
specification:
"A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will:
• Introduce a maximum penalty of life imprisonment for rape
• Increase maximum penalties for all serious sexual offences
• Introduce a new, standard sentence of 30 years for murder of a current or former partner
• Allow courts to consider patterns of sexual abuse by an accused at trial
• Toughen the law to stop barristers from using humiliating questioning techniques
• Introduce a new form of manslaughter to include where someone has taken their life due to family violence
• Increase the penalty for repeatedly breaching a Family Violence Intervention Order (FVIO)
• Create a new offence and amend the definition of family violence to cover when a perpetrator abandons a victim in medical need"

commitment: Provide more select-entry high schools
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will build three new select-entry high schools and transition six existing government schools to select or partial select-entry."

commitment: Build stage one of the Cardinia Life Sports and Aquatic Centre in Pakenham
specification: "A Jess Wilson led Liberal Government will deliver $20 million for the development of the first stage of the Cardinia Life Sports and Aquatic Centre in Pakenham. Stage one will deliver four new indoor courts (to bring the total to twelve), a 1,500-seat show court, a brand-new dedicated gymnastics facility and a refurbished foyer, changerooms, and car park."

commitment: Deliver a new STEAM centre at Koonung Secondary College in Mont Albert North
specification: "A Jess Wilson-led Liberal Government will deliver a new state-of-the-art STEAM centre for Koonung Secondary College in Mont Albert North. This new learning space will mean more opportunity for the next generation of students in science, technology, engineering, arts and mathematics."

commitment: Increase funding for TAFE
specification: "Only the Greens are calling for more funding so that we can expand free TAFE and match it with the teachers, teaching hours and improved class sizes needed to deliver it."

commitment: Introduce Jack's Law
specification:
"Jack’s Law – Stop and Search gives police the power to use a handheld metal detector ‘wand’ to search for knives. Under Labor’s plan:
• Jack’s Law – Stop and Search will be in place statewide by early 2027
• We will deliver 1,200 additional handheld metal detectors for police"

commitment: Invest $10 million in BlueHub to support police mental health
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will back BlueHub with more than $10 million in support."

commitment: Order an independent assessment of Western Renewables Link costs
specification: "I have ordered an immediate, independent assessment into the costs of the Western Renewables Link."

commitment: Ban advertising of junk food, alcohol and gambling
specification: "The Greens will ban advertising of junk food, alcohol and gambling on all state-owned billboards, buses and trams."

commitment: Create a public dental system
specification: "We will invest $3 billion over 10 years to expand free dental care to everyone across Victoria."

commitment: Develop a regional and rural health workforce strategy
specification: "The Greens will [...] develop a regional and rural health workforce strategy, to make sure country people can access care when they need it."

commitment: Establish a parliamentary inquiry into rural and regional healthcare
specification: "The Greens will establish a parliamentary inquiry into rural and regional healthcare in Victoria [...] to make sure country people can access care when they need it."

commitment: Free and universal access to abortion
specification: "The Greens believe everyone should have free and comprehensive access to abortion and contraception no matter where you live."

commitment: Spend 3% of existing health and health infrastructure budget on community health services
specification: "The Greens will make spending on community health services 3% of the existing health and health infrastructure budgets, so people across Melbourne and regional Victoria can access holistic care provided by publicly funded GPs and allied health, no matter where they live. This would be repriotised from admitted and non-admitted services".

commitment: Spend 5% of existing health budget on health promotion, including funding VicHealth
specification: "The Greens will make investment in prevention and health promotion 5% of our existing health budget [...] We will use this money to stop Labor from cutting VicHealth, and more."

commitment: Hire 1,500 more police officers
specification:
"To hire 1,500 more police and bring Victoria Police back to full force, Labor’s plan will:
• Open a new, permanent police academy in the western suburbs
• Support police with triple-squad graduations through metro and regional academies
• Bring in more trainers, upgrade facilities and speed up recruitment for ADF veterans and PSOs"

commitment: Upgrade and extend Thompsons Road between Berwick-Cranbourne Road and Cardinia Road
specification: "A Jess Wilson led Liberal and Nationals Government will invest in the quality roads Melbourne's outer south-east deserve by delivering a $607 million upgrade of Thompsons Road. This project will extend and duplicate an approximately 8.5 kilometre section of Thompsons Road between Berwick-Cranbourne Road, Clyde North and Cardinia Road, Officer South."

commitment: Implement the Motorcycle Safety Action Plan
specification: "The Motorcycle Safety Action Plan will improve motorcyclist safety by investing in safer roads, better protection, and stronger support for riders."

commitment: Wind up the Breakthrough Victoria component of Innovation Victoria
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will wind up the Breakthrough Victoria component of Innovation Victoria and divest its investments, saving taxpayers $1.27 billion over the next decade."

commitment: Whole-of-system reform to address family violence
specification: "We need to fundamentally strengthen how coercive control is identified, prevented and responded to. We need this across Victoria’s family violence and legal systems. A stronger focus on early intervention, safety and support is essential."

commitment: Retain Infrastructure Victoria
specification: "My adjournment is for the Minister for Finance and relates to the proposed axing of Infrastructure Victoria." "Will the minister reconsider this appalling decision?"

commitment: Upgrade the Hogans Road and Derrimut Road intersection in Hoppers Crossing/Tarneit
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will upgrade the Hogans Road and Derrimut Road intersection so locals in Hoppers Crossing and Tarneit can get around faster." "If re-elected Labor will invest $90 million to replace the roundabout with a signalised intersection."

commitment: Incorporate accommodation for health workers into new regional hospital developments
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals will also tackle one of the biggest barriers to attracting workers to the regions: somewhere to live. Where suitable, accommodation for health workers will be incorporated into new regional hospital developments, including West Gippsland Hospital and Mildura Base Public Hospital."

commitment: Invest $40 million to establish a Victorian Rural Health Workforce Incentive Scheme
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals will invest $40 million over four years to establish a Victorian Rural Health Workforce Incentive Scheme [...] Under the scheme, eligible health workers will receive upfront financial support of up to $10,000, and receive further incentives of up to $10,000 for each year they remain in the role."

commitment: Update the Environment Reference Standard to explicitly cover plastics and microplastics
specification: "My adjournment matter is for the Minister for Environment, Minister Symes. I call on the minister to ensure the EPA amends the environment reference standard to explicitly include plastics, including microplastics."

commitment: No change to abortion laws
specification: "Abortion law will not change under a Liberal and Nationals government. Full stop."

commitment: Upgrade the pavilion at Bruce Park Reserve in Frankston
specification: "A re-elected Carroll Labor Government will invest $3 million to help deliver a brand-new sporting pavilion at Bruce Park Reserve. [...] the redevelopment will deliver modern change rooms, multipurpose community spaces and accessible amenities that support football, cricket and tennis. The upgraded pavilion will also include public facilities for other users of the reserve."

commitment: Invest $288 million in a new Country Roads and Bridges program
specification: "Local roads that take regional Victorians home and to school, work and the shops will be improved under a $288 million investment in a new Country Roads and Bridges program by the Liberals and Nationals. Under this commitment each of Victoria's 48 rural and regional councils will receive $1.5 million every year for four years in untied funding for local roads and bridge upgrades."

commitment: No change to age of criminal responsibility
specification: "It [raising the age of criminal responsibility] certainly won't happen under a Liberals and Nationals government."

commitment: Return 25 three-car V/Line trains from the city to regional Victoria
specification: "Our plan to deliver suburban trains for Melbourne's west means 25 three-car V/Line trains currently being used in the city can be returned to regional Victoria."

commitment: Support Victorian businesses
specification:
"• Standardise local business laws across Victoria.
• Turn Service Victoria into a genuine one-stop shop.
• Establish a Business Approvals Concierge.
• Modernise planning rules for home-based businesses."

commitment: Implement the recommendations of the inquiry into climate resilience
specification: "The Greens are calling on Labor to urgently implement the climate resilience inquiry’s recommendations⁠, [including] establish[ing] a permanent fund to help households protect and adapt their homes, and make fossil fuel corporations pay for it."

commitment: Deliver 25 new hybrid electric trains for Melton and Wyndham Vale lines
specification: "A future Liberal and Nationals Government will invest $1.7 billion to deliver 25 new hybrid electric trains for the Melton and Wyndham Vale lines."

commitment: Establish a new and independent Public Transport Victoria (PTV) board
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will also establish a new and independent Public Transport Victoria (PTV) board to ensure Victoria's public transport system is fully focused on better service delivery for commuters and taxpayers."

commitment: Double registration fees for 'Truckzilla' vehicles with bonnets over 120cm
specification: "The Greens will double registration fees for vehicles with bonnets over 120cm – the Truckzillas that pose the greatest danger to pedestrians and cyclists."

commitment: Free and frequent public transport
specification:
"The Greens will:
