• Run trams at least every 10 minutes from 7am-10pm
• Run trains at least every 10 minutes from 7am-10pm across most of the network, where infrastructure allows
• Duplicate the Upfield line, so it can finally get a train every 10 minutes
• Spend $270 million to progressively reform buses into a fast, frequent grid, across suburban Melbourne, and upgrade local buses in regional Victoria
• Run regional trains and coaches more often, by investing $245 million in frequency improvements.
• And we will make public transport permanently free.

commitment: Improve transport planning
specification: "The Greens will give independent advisory body Infrastructure Victoria the power and resources to create a detailed Integrated Transport Plan, with a 30-year investment pipeline."

commitment: More bike lanes and better coordinated bike and scooter hire schemes
specification:
"We will commit 5% of the existing transport budget to building a network of safe bike routes across Melbourne and regional centres (the long promised Strategic Cycling Corridors). The Greens also want to see:
• More coordination of scooter and bike-hire schemes
• Scooters using bike lanes to keep footpaths clear for pedestrians and prams
• More bike racks on regional buses
• More bike parking at stations and bus stops
• 30 km/h speed limits in residential streets, around schools and in high pedestrian areas"

commitment: Take responsibility for the safety of our roads
specification: "Bring state road maintenance programs back in-house. Establish a website where you can report road issues that need attention. Deliver new, statewide standards for road quality and safety. Give our five road maintenance regions more power to prioritise local repairs. Work with Corrections Victoria on a pilot program to get supervised, minimum-security prisoners helping with basic roadside maintenance."

commitment: Ban gambling companies giving gifts to politicians
specification: "Today the Greens are bringing a motion to ban gambling companies giving ‘gifts’ to politicians."

commitment: Retract fines given to farmers for blocking renewable energy contractors from accessing their land
specification: "Opposition Leader Jess Wilson confirmed if elected, the Liberal-Nationals would not only scrap the VNI West transmission line project, they would not enforce the fines." "It's absolutely disgraceful what this Labor government has done when it comes to fining farmers for [blocking access to] authorised officers to come onto their own property."

commitment: Expand the SACStat database to give the public access to sentencing information
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals will expand the Sentencing Advisory Council's SACStat database to include Children's Court sentencing data, along with more comprehensive anonymised information on sentencing outcomes, ranges and trends, so Victorians can see what sentences are actually being handed down across the justice system."

commitment: Strengthen the Sentencing Advisory Council to independently initiate reviews of sentencing practices
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals will also strengthen the Sentencing Advisory Council to independently initiate reviews of sentencing trends and practices, and report on whether sentencing practices reflect the intent of legislation and community expectations."

commitment: Invest $20 million to create a new park at the old Box Hill Brickworks site
specification: Leader of the Opposition, Jess Wilson, said: "We know how important greenspace is for the local community in Box Hill, and that's why we are committing $20 million to help turn the Box Hill Brickworks site into a public parkland the whole community can enjoy."

commitment: Split Victoria's Court of Appeal into separate Court of Criminal Appeal and Court of Civil Appeal
specification: "As part of the Liberals and Nationals' plan to restore community safety, a Jess Wilson-led government will split the existing Court of Appeal into two separate courts - a Court of Criminal Appeal and a Court of Civil Appeal - allowing additional judges specialising in criminal matters to be appointed to the new standalone Court of Criminal Appeal."

commitment: Restore move-on laws and re-establish exclusion orders for repeat offenders
specification: "Introduce a public order package to restore move-on laws and re-establish exclusion orders for repeat offenders."

commitment: $2.8 million for the Indian Film Festival of Melbourne
specification: "Opposition Leader Jess Wilson has pledged $2.8 million over four years, or $700,000 annually, to support the future growth of IFFM if the Liberal and Nationals form government after the November election."

commitment: Fund a CCTV network on Pakington Street in Geelong
specification: "This investment by a Liberal and Nationals government, a $50,000 investment in nine CCTV cameras, is an incredibly important part of our plan to reduce crime right across Victoria."

commitment: Introduce a $50 per week toll cap for road users
specification: "A future Liberal and Nationals Government will introduce a weekly toll cap of $50 for two years from 1 July 2027."

commitment: $600K to fund the Indian Film Festival of Melbourne for two more years
specification: "Labor is investing in Victoria's multicultural community, locking in two more years of the Indian Film Festival of Melbourne (IFFM). Minister for Creative Industries Vicki Ward today announced a $600,000 election commitment to continue the largest celebration of Indian cinema in the Southern Hemisphere."

commitment: Reverse ban on replacing gas appliances and gas connections in new estates
specification: "Only a Jess Wilson-led Liberal and Nationals Government will restore consumer choice by reversing Labor's gas ban."

commitment: A living wage for artists
specification: "The Greens want a living wage for artists, giving practicing artists and arts workers a living wage and the freedom to experiment, develop and create new work."

commitment: Address Victoria’s specialist teacher shortage
specification: "All public school students should have access to free music, drama and language education. The Greens will take action to address Victoria’s specialist teacher shortage."

commitment: Advocate for fair treatment for migrant workers
specification: "The Greens will advocate for enforcement of workers rights for migrants and improved data collection of fair working conditions and pay."

commitment: Ban big corporate donations to politicians
specification: "The Greens will get money out of politics by banning big corporate donations to politicians, candidates and political parties. We'll stop vested interests, like the gambling, pokies and property industries, and fossil fuel corporations, from buying influence."

commitment: Ban gambling advertising
specification: "Like tobacco, gambling ads don’t belong on billboards, buses or broadcasts – or your kid’s socials feeds. The Greens are committed to banning gambling advertising across the country."

commitment: Ban more single-use plastic
specification: "The Greens will ban more single-use plastics, like bread tags, soy sauce fish, coffee cups, produce bags and fruit and veg stickers. We will also ban giving out disposable cups, etc., to people who are dining in, and unnecessary plastic wrapping of items for sale."

commitment: Ban the use of sniffer dogs for drug detection
specification: "We want festivals to be a safe, fun and supportive environment for the diverse range of people. The use of drug detection sniffer dogs is out of step, unsafe and does nothing to protect people from drug-related harm."

commitment: Ban waste-to-energy incinerators
specification: "Burning our waste can be more emissions-intensive than coal and is the last thing our climate needs right now. So the Victorian Greens are calling for an immediate moratorium on waste incineration projects."

commitment: Better support for carers
specification: "We want to see increased funding and improved respite support for all carers, so they have the financial security and time to take care of their own health and wellbeing."

commitment: Bring back paid sick leave for casual workers
specification: "The Greens will bring back sick pay for casual workers, with five days of paid sick or carers leave each year, giving people the opportunity to take care of their health, or care for loved ones when they need it, without the worry of losing income. The Greens will commit $100 million to restart the scheme."

commitment: Cap election campaign spending and donations to local government campaigns
specification: "The Greens will cap campaign spending, like they have in New South Wales and the ACT. We have been key to securing donations caps in state politics, and the Greens will introduce caps to local government elections, so the local developer can’t fund getting the pro-developer candidate elected."

commitment: Cap vice-chancellor salaries
specification: "The Greens will cap vice-chancellor salaries, so more university funding can go towards providing quality education."

commitment: Celebrate Pride and fund LGBTQIA+ events
specification: "The Greens want to see long-term funding for Pride and community celebrations, and LGBTQIA+ community events and festivals across the state."

commitment: Continue the roll out of free mental health care
specification: We will continue the roll out of free mental health care across the state

commitment: Decriminalise personal use and possession of small quantities of drugs
specification: "Drug use in our community needs a health response, not a crime-based response. Decriminalising personal use and possession in small quantities means people get the support they need without fear or stigma."

commitment: Deliver promised housing support for people with complex mental health challenges
specification: "The Labor government promised $40 million in housing support for people with complex mental health and psychosocial challenges. The Greens will make sure this funding is delivered. "

commitment: Develop a plan to address early learning deserts
specification: "Large swathes of Victoria, especially in regional areas, don’t have enough early childhood education options for families. The Greens will develop a plan to address early learning deserts, with more government-funded and not-for-profit centres in these early learning deserts."

commitment: Embed First Nations perspectives in early childhood education
specification: "Truthtelling and self-determination are important values to First Nations communities and the Greens want to see First Nations frameworks and ways of knowing embedded in early childhood education."

commitment: End contracts and state support for weapons companies supplying the US and Israel
specification: "The Greens pledge to end all state contracts, grants and industry support for the supply of weapons or weapon components to the United States and Israel, and immediately withdraw the Victorian Government from supporting the global weapons supply chains, starting with those used in Israel’s genocide in Palestine."

commitment: End government sponsorship and support for weapons expos
specification: "The Greens are calling for an end to government sponsorship and support for arms trade fairs."

commitment: Equal access to education for children with disabilities
specification: "The Greens want disabled kids to have equal access to education. More flexible school zoning should be considered, to enable disabled kids to attend schools which can cater to their needs. The Greens also want to see schools and their teaching staff have the necessary resources to support children with disabilities."

commitment: Establish a $2 billion seed fund to fund nature protection properly
specification: "The Greens will create a $2 billion seed fund to reverse Labor’s cuts to nature protection and fund First Nations-led work protecting and restoring Country [...] and use our fund to invest in controlling invasive species like rabbits, feral cats, and fire ants."

commitment: Establish an independent school building authority and properly maintain schools
specification: "The Greens will establish an independent school building authority, so decisions about school building are based on need instead of marginal seats, and our schools are properly maintained."

commitment: Establish an Office of Research Integrity
specification: "The Greens believe Victoria needs an Office of Research Integrity, to complement existing institutional processes. It would have the power to review university and institutional investigations into misconduct and initiate its own where these are found to be inadequate."

commitment: Expand access to overdose prevention services
specification: "The Greens want to see access to medically supervised injecting services expanded, as well as more access to lifesaving naloxone vending machines, hydromorphone and other pharmacotherapies."

commitment: Expand pill testing
specification: "The Greens want to see pill testing expanded, to protect more people from preventable drug overdose across the state."

commitment: Expand the Container Deposit Scheme and increase the refund on bottles and cans
specification: "The Greens want to see the refund on bottles and cans increased from 10 cents to 20 cents to encourage more people to participate, the scheme expanded to include wine and spirit bottles, and better access to refund sites."

commitment: Fully fund schools
specification: "The Greens believe all government schools should be funded to the full amount recommended by the Gonski review."

commitment: Fund local government properly and abolish rate capping
specification: "The Greens want the state government to pay their fair share for programs and services that communities rely on. At the same time, a one size fits all approach to rates isn’t working, and is also leading to community services and jobs being cut. The Greens will abolish rate capping so councils can work together with their communities to set rates according to local needs."

commitment: Fund more LGBTQIA+ community services
specification: "The Greens will push for more funding for community-controlled organisations that support young people, healthcare, and mental health and fight homelessness within the LGBTQIA+ community. We also want more support for LGBTQIA+ people who have experienced conversion practices and improved access to state-run, free sexual health care for LGBTQIA+ people."

commitment: Fund the Victorian Early Childhood Regulatory Authority appropriately
specification: "After shocking revelations of abuse and mistreatment in Victorian childcare centres, the Greens want the Victorian Early Childhood Regulatory Authority to be funded appropriately. This is to effectively enforce child safety standards to ensure these incidents never occur again to our most vulnerable members of the community."

commitment: Get weapons out of education
specification: "The Greens will require full transparency for all defence-linked research partnerships at publicly funded universities. We will attach strict human rights and ethical due-diligence conditions to state funding, ensuring no Victorian public institution partners with companies involved in the manufacture or supply of weapons used in violations of international law."

commitment: Halt approval of new AI data centres
specification: "The Greens are calling for a moratorium on all new AI data centres until communities have actually had an opportunity to consider the risks and benefits, and create strong laws to protect people and the planet over big tech profit."

commitment: Increase funding for Operational Infrastructure Support to support research institutes
specification: "The Greens believe the government should increase funding for Operational Infrastructure Support so that medical research institutes can meet their basic running costs."

commitment: Introduce a comprehensive AI Act to protect workers, artists, and our data
specification: "We need an AI Act that protects workers from unfair job losses and surveillance at work, stops the great AI art theft and forces big companies to pay creatives fairly, choice and transparency when it comes to our personal data, and ban the use of Victorian data centres for autonomous weapons."

commitment: Introduce legislation to stop public services being sold off
specification: "Introduce legislation to stop public services being sold off."

commitment: Introduce Truth in Political Advertising laws
specification: "Victoria lacks laws to prevent candidates from getting elected on the basis of lies and misinformation. The Greens will introduce South Australian-style Truth in Political Advertising Laws."

commitment: Investigate embedding anti-racism education in schools
specification: "The Greens will investigate embedding anti-racism, social cohesion and inclusion programs in the curriculum for all Victorian schools."

commitment: Investigate how to get a soft plastics recycling scheme up and running again
specification: "The Greens will investigate how to develop a soft plastics recycling scheme which turns plastics into needed products, doesn’t result in huge stockpiles and doesn’t use toxic technologies like pyrolysis."

commitment: Keep live music alive
specification: "The Greens will push the government to find real solutions to support our local live music venues, including a way to regulate or provide affordable insurance."

commitment: Legalise cannabis
specification: "The Greens propose a legally regulated, taxed, and quality-controlled industry for cannabis that will improve consumer safety, undercut organised crime and focus on harm reduction."

commitment: Less government spending on executives and consultants
specification: "The Greens want to see less spending on government department executive salaries, and commit to halving government spending on consultancies, so there is more money available to protect public service jobs."

commitment: Make it easier to reuse
specification: "The Greens will make it easier to reuse, by supporting schools to increase reuse of school uniforms, and op-shops that specialise in particular products like baby equipment, tested household appliances, and sports gear. We also want to see reuse strategies developed for items like secondhand furniture and single-use medical products that can be sterilised and reused."

commitment: More accessible tram stops
specification: "The Greens believe it’s time for much more investment in accessible tram stops."

commitment: More funding for community and not-for-profit early childhood education and care
specification: "The Greens want to see more funding for community and not-for-profit early childhood education and care, to expand access and increase quality."

commitment: More funding for libraries
specification: "The Greens will push for libraries to be better funded."

commitment: More support for foster, kinship and permanent carers of children
specification: "We know that less foster carers are putting their hands up, and cost of living is having an impact on everyone. The Greens want foster, kinship and permanent carers to be fairly supported to provide safe, stable homes for children."

commitment: No more pokies
specification: "The Greens want tougher rules on pokies now to reduce harm, and ultimately for pokies to be phased out of pubs and clubs in our communities."

commitment: Protect artists from censorship and AI
specification: "To maintain artists’ autonomy, diversity, courage and authenticity, the Greens will strengthen arts policy to ensure that creative funding bodies’ decisions are at arm’s length without interference from the government."

commitment: Protect native forests and close loopholes that allow under-the-radar logging
specification:
"The Greens will close Labor’s logging loopholes and protect our forests for good. We will:
• Repeal laws that would enable future governments to bring back native logging on public land.
• Create permanent legal protections, and new national parks and reserves, to protect forests in the Central Highlands and East Gippsland, with Traditional Owners' rights and management front and centre.
• Make it illegal for mills in Victoria to process native forest timber from anywhere in Australia.
• Ban logging in native forests on private land (not including sustainable plantations).
• Create real accountability by empowering the Environment Protection Authority and Office of the Conservation Regulator to investigate Forest Fire Management Victoria."

commitment: Protect our art spaces
specification: "As well as protecting and better funding our art spaces [...] the Greens are pushing for planning protections to safeguard the vital infrastructure that arts and culture relies on, and for major new developments to contribute a “Percent-for-Art”. The Greens will also expand the vacancy property tax to cover commercial properties to encourage property owners to lease or sell underutilised properties, creating an incentive to establish studios and temporary exhibition spaces in empty premises."

commitment: Protect the NDIS
specification: "The Greens will work with our Greens colleagues in the federal Parliament to fight the NDIS cuts and make sure disabled people get the dignity, respect and sustainable funding they deserve to live a good life."

commitment: Provide better funding for neighbourhood houses
specification: "Neighbourhood Houses are a key part of connecting up our communities. They deserve reliable, ongoing funding, so they can continue to provide the services people need."

commitment: Reform freedom of information laws
specification: "The Greens will reform freedom of information laws so people can always obtain any information about themselves held by the government, along with all key reports, records and data relating to government decision making."

commitment: Reform the City of Melbourne voting system
specification: "We will end automatic enrolment of businesses and non-residents, mandate timely declarations of donations and introduce restrictions on donations (including banning property developer donations). We will get rid of the rule that gives businesses more votes than residents, and expand methods of voting that maximise participation and accessibility."

commitment: Reform Victoria's prison and criminal justice system
specification: "The Greens will raise the age of criminal responsibility to 14. We will also repeal Labor’s 2025 bail changes and life sentences for kids. The Greens also believe that healthcare in prison shouldn’t be provided by for-profit companies. And for First Nations prisoners, it should be provided specifically by Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Organisations who understand their community’s needs and lives and can provide better and more culturally-safe care."

commitment: Remove barriers to gender affirming care
specification: "The Greens want to improve access to gender-affirming healthcare for trans and gender-diverse people to improve waitlists and ensure people receive care in a timely way."

commitment: Require police to improve data collection on the people police interact with
specification: "The Greens will require police to improve data collection on racial appearance [of the people police interact with], and to publish it."

commitment: Require public sector organisations to collect data on workforce racial diversity
specification: "Public sector organisations are already required to monitor gender data collection to improve gender equality. This should be extended to racial diversity data collected to make sure our public sector is truly representative not just in the workforce but also in leadership roles."

commitment: Restructure environment department to put nature and First Nations knowledge first
specification: "The Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action often puts the interests of industry on equal (or greater) footing with environmental protection. The Greens will restructure it so that nature protection and First Nations knowledge is the primary mandate, not giving corporations what they want to make more profit."

commitment: Review university governance
specification: "This work will begin with a review of the eight public university acts in Victoria, to make sure they are fit for our modern academic system and are working to ensure the best outcomes for students and staff."

commitment: Rewrite planning rules for liveable cities and towns
specification: "The Greens will rewrite the planning rules to increase density around transport hubs and properly protect green wedges, while restoring power to councils and communities, strengthening environmental protection, and conserving public space." "The Greens will rewrite the planning rules to require more green space and with a target of 40% tree canopy cover in urban areas." "The Greens will rewrite the planning laws to strengthen these [sustainable homes] requirements." "The Greens will rewrite our planning laws to strengthen environmental protection in all planning decisions."

commitment: Scale up public rehabilitation beds and addiction support
specification: "The Greens will develop a plan to significantly scale up public rehabilitation beds and addiction support over the next five years, to help more people get the healthcare they need when they need it."

commitment: Stop fossil fuel and mining projects
specification: "The Greens will block all new fossil fuel projects in Victoria and investigate what can be done to halt the expansion of the Ballarat and Fosterville Gold Mines [...] We will also block the revival of the Fingerboards Mineral Sands Project."

commitment: Stop private schools from getting more than their fair share
specification: "The Greens will stop private schools from getting more than their share of public money, by capping their funding at 100% of the funding the Gonski review said was needed to meet students’ educational needs."

commitment: Stop the spread of anti-LGBTQIA+ hate online and in public spaces
specification: "The Greens want stricter regulation of social media companies to prevent the spread of hateful content targeting LGBTQIA+ people and other marginalised groups, and regulation of dating platforms to prevent tech-faciliated hate and violence."

commitment: Strengthen disability employment practices in the public sector
specification: "The Greens will ensure stronger targets in the public sector, as well as government procurement processes that reward businesses with best practice disability employment practices."

commitment: Strengthen protections for family violence victims' life insurance
specification: "No one should be profiting from violence, that's why the Greens want to see all loopholes for financial abuse closed to protect the victim and their families. Closing these loopholes will ensure perpetrators convicted of family violence offences will not benefit or be able to access their victim's life insurance or superannuation’s funds."

commitment: Strict environmental and water standards for AI data centres
specification: "The Greens will regulate strict standards for data centres to ensure they can’t drain our water or damage our environment and native biodiversity."

commitment: Stronger regulation of alcohol and gambling to reduce family violence harm
specification: "The Greens believe we need stronger regulation of alcohol and gambling to reduce harm, improve community safety, and support prevention efforts. Simple measures, such as mandatory delays on alcohol home deliveries, can make a meaningful difference."

commitment: Support early and mid-career researchers
specification: "The Greens want more support for early and mid-career researchers, particularly women and those affected by interruptions to their careers."

commitment: Support for small to medium arts and screen organisations
specification: "The Greens want increased funding and long-term grants for our small to medium arts organisations." "The Greens will give VicScreen the power to approve large investment amounts for projects without having to wait sometimes months for Cabinet approval."

commitment: Support older Victorians in retirement villages and residential parks
specification: "There is a long history of some retirement villages and residential parks exploiting residents and potential residents. The Greens want more support for older Victorians with contracts, complaints and conflict. "

commitment: Support people targeted by racism
specification: "The Greens want to see more programs that provide intentional, culturally safe and trauma informed support for people targeted by racialised abuse."

commitment: Support working from home and a four day work week
specification: "The Greens support the right to work from home, and will also work towards a four day work week in the public sector, giving people more time for their families and loved ones while creating thousands of jobs."

commitment: Transform WorkCover to truly support workers
specification: "The current Workcover current system has too many delays and makes decisions which prioritise profit over recovery, particularly for workers with psychological injuries. The Greens will review WorkCover to turn it into a compassionate and people-centred scheme."

commitment: Free bus travel
specification: "Legalise Cannabis MP Rachel Payne said bus infrastructure was a “lot easier” to activate outer-suburban areas, with each bus taking 50 cars off the road. “It makes a lot of sense. We’ve been always supportive of buses, and we’d like them to be free and accessible,” she said."

commitment: Restore effective wild dog control
specification: "A Liberals and Nationals Government will restore effective wild dog control and give farmers the tools they need to protect their livestock and livelihoods."

commitment: Apply the council rates cap to council waste charges
specification: "We will also apply the rates cap to council waste charges."

commitment: Require councils to provide a weekly general rubbish collection
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will require councils to provide Victorian households with a weekly general rubbish collection."

commitment: Review the rate of the landfill levy
specification: "An incoming Liberal and Nationals Government will review the rate of the landfill levy alongside our previously announced review of the container deposit scheme."

commitment: Extend the Alexis-Family Violence Response Model
specification: Extend the Alexis-Family Violence Response Model to all Family Violence Investigation Units in Victoria Police.

commitment: Deploy PSOs to major hospitals
specification: "Under the Liberals and Nationals' plan, 70 PSOs will be deployed for a two-year pilot at seven major hospitals across Victoria."

commitment: Hold a cannabis legalisation plebiscite
specification: Hold a Cannabis Legalisation Plebiscite to ask Victorians whether they back legalising personal cannabis use, possession and home cultivation.

commitment: Abolish street auctions
specification: "Under the plan, street auctions would be banned, reserve prices would be disclosed upfront, real estate agents and buyers' agents would be required to declare fixed fees, and vendors would pay for building & pest reports."

commitment: Ban duck shooting
specification: "The Greens will ban duck shooting for good, and make our wetlands safe for regional communities and nature-based tourism."

commitment: Ban greyhound racing
specification: "The Greens will ban greyhound racing, with a welfare plan for the future of greyhounds currently in the industry, and a just plan for trainers and other workers to transition to other employment."

commitment: Ban old mines from using river and ground water
specification: "The Greens are calling [...] to ban old mines from using river and ground water, instead requiring them to pay for their own alternative sustainable sources like recycled water."

commitment: Defund horse racing and ban jumps racing
specification: "The Greens will defund racing by cancelling financial support. We will also join every other state in Australia in acknowledging the cruelty of jumps racing, and ban it in Victoria."

commitment: Develop a Victorian Food Sovereignty Plan
specification: "The Greens will develop a Victorian Food Sovereignty Plan to ensure our food systems are resilient, green wedges are legislatively protected, and that all Victorians can access local affordable nutritious food in the face of global and climate shocks."

commitment: Establish a Victorian Centre for Regenerative Agriculture
specification: "The Greens want to see a research centre established to help farmers reduce reliance on pesticides and synthetic fertilisers, reduce emissions, and build climate resilience."

commitment: Establish an independent authority to protect the rights of animals
specification: "The interests of animals can’t be in the same hands as the authority for the industries that profit from them. The Greens will create a separate independent authority to monitor and protect the rights of animals."

commitment: Expand IBAC's powers
specification: "The Greens say that follow-the-dollar powers will be almost meaningless without also expanding what IBAC can investigate and without letting it hold public hearings." "The Greens say if new Premier Ben Carroll has only introduced follow-the-money powers without expanding the definition of corrupt conduct to allow it to look into all forms of corruption - not just the incredible high bar of indictable offences - Labor will just be managing the headlines but not fixing the problem."

commitment: Fix Victoria's wildlife laws
specification: "We’ll overhaul our wildlife laws and fix the permit system that allows massive numbers of native animals to be killed. We'll make sure threatened species don't just get listed - they get a real plan to help them recover. And we will redirect the funding which currently goes to promoting recreational hunting to protecting species and habitat instead."

commitment: Phase out intensive animal farming
specification: "The Greens will phase out intensive animal farming, including battery cages and sow stalls."

commitment: Protect Victoria’s rivers and waterways
specification: "The Greens want Victoria’s rivers and waterways to be recognised as living entities" "We also want to see more respect for Traditional Owner water rights" "We will also introduce a moratorium on new water licences, and develop a plan to return water for healthy rivers."

commitment: Support small scale farming
specification: "The Greens want to see small scale farming supported through apprenticeships for new farmers and peppercorn leases of public and crown land."

commitment: Boost recycling
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will target landfill reduction by boosting recycling through upgrades to high capacity regional sorting facilities and strengthening existing recycling markets."

commitment: Bring back 2km buffer zones for wind turbines
specification: "Sensible 2km buffer zones will be brought back so wind turbines cannot be built close to people’s homes."

commitment: Build new ambulance stations
specification: "We will also build new ambulance stations, including at Armstrong Creek, Mansfield and Donnybrook."

commitment: Conduct audits of Victoria’s agricultural land
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals will conduct audits of Victoria’s agricultural land to identify and protect the state’s best farming country."

commitment: Create a Victorian Nighttime Economy Strategy
specification: "We will create a Victorian Nighttime Economy Strategy to coordinate activities and regulation reforms across government agencies to simplify the rules and processes for venues, promoters and festival organisers."

commitment: Criminalise coercive control
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will criminalise coercive control."

commitment: Energy Security Requirement
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals’ Energy Security Requirement will ensure Victoria has sufficient power to meet our needs by securing additional new firm electricity generation through competitive tenders."

commitment: Expand the Capital City Zone
specification: "Our Plan will expand the Capital City Zone into targeted parts of the inner city surrounding the CBD to enable additional, well-connected housing growth."

commitment: Fund additional hospital inpatient beds
specification: "Our Plan includes [...] funding additional inpatient beds."

commitment: Improve ambulance dispatch decisions and response times
specification: "Our Plan includes putting experienced paramedics into the Triple Zero call-taking process to improve dispatch decisions and ensure a focus on priority responses."

commitment: Invest $132 million in a Mental Health Early Access Plan
specification: "Our Plan will invest $132 million in a Mental Health Early Access Plan to strengthen community-led early intervention and prevention."

commitment: Invest $15 million to establish a Nursery & Garden Industry Victoria Horticulture Centre of Excellence
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will invest $15 million to establish the Nursery & Garden Industry Victoria Horticulture Centre of Excellence, building workforce capability, strengthening food production, and developing solutions to restore Victoria’s urban tree canopy."

commitment: No new or increased taxes
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will guarantee no new or increased taxes."

commitment: Prioritise the core maintenance functions of Parks Victoria
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will restore public confidence in public land management by prioritising the core maintenance functions of Parks Victoria. We will ensure public walking tracks are open and safe, upgrade campsite amenities, and improve accessibility for all Victorians."

commitment: Publish real time emergency department waiting and capacity information
specification: "Our Plan includes [...] publishing real time ED waiting and capacity information to support a focus on critical and life threatening conditions."

commitment: Repeal compulsory land acquisition laws
specification: "We will repeal laws that allow farmland to be compulsorily acquired for transmission line projects before environmental and planning approvals, including Environmental Effects Statements (EES), are complete."

commitment: Restore landholders' right to appeal major planning and infrastructure decisions to VCAT
specification: "We will restore the right of affected landholders to appeal major planning and infrastructure decisions to VCAT." "This will ensure landholders and regional communities are not shut out of decisions that directly impact their land and livelihoods."

commitment: Scrap high-rise activity centres
specification: "And we will scrap Labor’s high-rise activity centres that sideline local residents from planning decisions and that force one-size-fits-all housing options on communities across Melbourne."

commitment: Support major events
specification: "Our Plan will support major events with free public transport for events, activation spaces for promoters and an events concierge to create a single point of contact for event organisers to make it easier to run events in Victoria."

commitment: Keep Victoria’s council rate cap
specification: "A government I lead will keep Victoria’s council rate cap, protecting Victorian families from higher rates during a cost of living crisis."

commitment: Build new West Gippsland Hospital
specification: "An elected Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will deliver a new $850 million West Gippsland Hospital in Drouin East, including: 230 beds and treatment spaces, An emergency department with 33 treatment spaces, Modern training facilities, 60 residential care beds, Accommodation for healthcare workers."

commitment: Develop a long term plan for Victoria's racing industry
specification: "A future Liberal and Nationals Government will work alongside the thoroughbred, harness and greyhound racing codes to ensure Victoria remains the home of Australia's premier racing events for the next decade and beyond. Our focus will be on providing certainty, encouraging investment, strengthening regional racing and ensuring all three codes have the confidence to plan for the future."

commitment: Abolish property investor subsidies
specification: "End the BTR land tax and absentee owner exemptions and put money back into local communities for the things we need."

commitment: Close loophole that requires councillors to stand down
specification:
"The Greens are calling on the Government to:
• Introduce urgent standalone legislation during the next sitting week to restore democratic decision-making at Hepburn Shire Council while broader local government reforms are considered.
• Support urgent intervention by the Director of Public Prosecutions to determine whether the current private prosecutions should proceed, helping resolve the uncertainty facing the council and community.
The Greens warn the same legislative loophole could affect any Victorian council unless Parliament acts."

commitment: End homelessness within 10 years
specification: "Legislate a goal to end homelessness by 2036." "Guarantee long-term funding for homelessness services and funding for specialised housing for high-risk and vulnerable cohorts."

commitment: Make developers provide affordable housing
specification:
"The Greens will increase the supply of affordable housing by:
• Requiring a minimum of 30% genuinely affordable housing in new private developments of 15 units or more across the state.
• Prohibiting the sale or lease of public housing land to private developers, or the construction of private homes on public land.
• Legislating a definition of “affordable” that keeps rent within 30% of the tenant’s income, not tied to the market."

commitment: Make housing a human right
specification: "Enshrine the right to housing in the Victorian Charter of Human Rights."

commitment: Upgrade Wonthaggi Hospital
specification: "An elected Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will invest $350 million to deliver stages two and three of the Wonthaggi Hospital redevelopment."

commitment: Wipe COVID-19 fines
specification: "Victorian Opposition Leader Jess Wilson said it was time to wipe the fines rather than hold them over people’s heads."

commitment: Extend truck bans in Melbourne's west
specification: "The Victorian Greens have renewed calls for extended truck bans and a proper crackdown on trucks rat running through residential streets" "We need truck bans in our Kensington, North Melbourne and West Melbourne communities now."

commitment: Promote the benefits of switching from gas to electrical projects
specification: "The Greens are calling on the Victorian Labor Government to counter the millions being spent by the gas lobby and invest in a mass public communication focused on the benefits of switching to cheap, clean electrical projects."

commitment: Introduce new workplace surveillance protection laws
specification: "No weird, invasive spying on workers. No AI bias in recruitment. Workers have the right to know. Humans must have the final say."

commitment: Literacy and Numeracy Guarantee
specification:
"The Literacy and Numeracy Guarantee will establish:
• An interim target of a 15% increase on current levels over 10 years across the NAPLAN domains of literacy and numeracy. [...]
• A long-term goal of 90% proficiency across the NAPLAN domains of literacy and numeracy.
To back teachers to deliver these outcomes, a Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will expand professional learning for teachers [...] and review Victoria's curriculum to better prepare students for life while reducing workload on teachers."

commitment: Give VCAT new powers to make demasking orders
specification: "Labor will give VCAT new powers to make ‘demasking orders’ – forcing social media companies to reveal the identity of anonymous users accused of online vilification."

commitment: Make it easier to sue social media and AI providers over child harm
specification: "Labor will remove that threshold [that requires proof of a permanent impairment of 10 per cent or more] for claims brought on behalf of minors against social media and AI providers, making it easier for families to hold them to account."

commitment: Invest $100 million into youth crime prevention initiatives
specification: "Our $100 million plan to invest in early intervention to make sure we help keep kids connected to school, make sure they're connected to local sporting clubs, and we don't see them head down a path of crime in the first place."

commitment: Repeal the fourth bin mandate and review Victoria's Container Deposit Scheme
specification: "An elected Liberal and Nationals Government will repeal the mandate [for councils to introduce a separate purple-lidded bin for glass] and review Victoria's Container Deposit Scheme."

commitment: Upgrade Brighton Primary School
specification: "A Liberals and Nationals Government will provide Brighton Primary School with funding to deliver a school masterplan and Stage 1 works which include new junior toilets, replacement of the school's ageing demountable classrooms, and an upgrade to the library."

commitment: $500K for frontline support centre on the Mornington Peninsula
specification: "We had the privilege earlier of going to our local frontline support centre, we made a commitment during the by-election and leading into November that we'll give them $250K to help them do that much needed work."

commitment: Rebuild Rosebud Hospital
specification: "We are absolutely committed to rebuilding the Rosebud hospital, a $340 million investment by the Liberals to ensure that residents down here on the peninsula get access to the quality health care that they deserve."

commitment: Mandate domestic, family and sexual violence education for year 10-12 students
specification: "The Victorian Greens are calling for the Victorian State Government to [...] mandate domestic violence, family and sexual violence education for year 10-12 students."

commitment: Limit MP travel allowance to domestic travel
specification: "In response, Wilson has pledged to treat taxpayer money 'with respect' and rein in the perk by limiting the allowance to domestic travel, only if successful on election day."

commitment: Build a new secondary school in Mount Duneed
specification: "Liberal Leader Jess Wilson said: [South Barwon candidate] Libby [Pettit] and I will make sure this school gets built within the first term of a government I lead'." "Opposition education spokesman Brad Rowswell said a Coalition government would act quickly to make the project a reality."

commitment: Increase the speed limit on Princes freeway and highway
specification: "Motorists have been restricted to 100kmph on the Princes freeway and highway between Melbourne and Colac, despite this section being fully duplicated and modernised over recent years. A future Wilson O'Brien Liberal and Nationals Government will increase the speed limit on this section to 110kmph."

commitment: Repair and rebuild Victoria's roads
specification:
"The Liberals and Nationals plan will:
• Invest $5 billion in road maintenance ​over four years, a 25 per cent increase on current spending
• Establish Better Roads Victoria as a standalone division within the Department of Transport and Planning, rebuilding the technical and engineering expertise lost when the Allan Labor government abandoned VicRoads and axed Regional Roads Victoria
• Boost roadside maintenance such as grass slashing, graffiti removal and drain clearance
• Lift departmental and contractor accountability through a review of construction standards and maintenance contracts."

commitment: Upgrade Hamilton Base Hospital
specification: "This $45 million commitment [to build a new emergency department and refurbished intensive care unit at Hamilton Base Hospital] will give Western District Health Service the modern intensive care unit and emergency department this community has been calling for."

commitment: Open Victoria for new gas exploration
specification: "We will launch a statewide Request for Proposal process." "At the same time, we will slash unnecessary red tape by streamlining State environmental approvals, so projects no longer face years of costly and avoidable delays. Furthermore, a future Liberal and Nationals Government will form an Energy and Resources Cabinet sub-committee to oversee the process of examining proposals and prioritising the issuing of permits."

commitment: Pause and review the Suburban Rail Loop project
specification: "'I have serious concerns about the cost of this project,'' Wilson said. ''Right now we don't have all the answers. We don't have any transparency of the contracts, we don't have any transparency of the financing arrangements. The most responsible thing we can do, and what we have said, is we will pause and review it."

commitment: Cut stamp duty
specification: "Cut stamp duty for owner occupiers: abolishing stamp duty for homes up to $1.1 million, and reduced stamp duty on a sliding scale up to $1.6 million."

commitment: Increase land tax for investors owning more than $5 million in residential properties
specification: "Increase land tax to 5.3% for property investors that own more than $5 million in residential investment properties, raising $6.4 billion over the decade."

commitment: Stop the demolition, build more public homes, and maintain and upgrade existing public housing
specification: "Stop the demolition and build more public housing: more than double the number of public homes - building over 88,000 public homes, maintaining and upgrading existing public housing with an initial investment of $4 billion."

commitment: Exempt Victorian government projects from Commonwealth powers to preference employers with enterprise agreements for federally-funded projects
specification: "Ms Wilson warned that a future coalition government in Victoria would exempt state government projects from the commonwealth regime and, if necessary, legislate to ensure the protections remained in place."

commitment: Stop Wodonga Golf Course from being rezoned for housing development
specification: "Saving the golf course has been adopted by Liberal candidate for Benambra Steve Martin as an election promise, which was endorsed by party leader Ms Wilson. 'It's an absolute commitment for us,' Ms Wilson told The Border Mail. 'We at the Liberals and Nationals with Steve and our team we'll make sure that we save the golf course.'."

commitment: Upgrade the Maroondah Highway and Killara Road intersection
specification: "Community pressure continues to mount in Coldstream, as calls for the intersection upgrade at Killara Road and Maroondah Highway remains a top priority. ... Ms Wilson said that under an elected Liberal government, she promised to deliver this project in her four-year term."

commitment: Upgrade Rochester Recreation Reserve
specification: "$4 million commitment to upgrade the Rochester Football Netball Club [at Rochester Recreation Reserve] with new clubrooms and change rooms."

commitment: Duplicate Donnybrook Road and remove level crossing at Donnybrook train station
specification: "Under the Liberals and Nationals' commitment, the entire 8-kilometre section of Donnybrook Road from Epping Road, Woodstock to Dwyer Street, Kalkallo will be duplicated and the level crossing at Donnybrook train station will be removed."

commitment: Establish an independent rental industry regulator
specification:
"We’ll crack down on dodgy landlords with an independent regulator who will:
• Establish a landlord licensing scheme, with revocation of licences for serious or multiple breaches
• Require rent-worthy certificates and energy efficiency disclosure for all leases on advertising
• Conduct independent inspections and enforce penalties for failing to meet minimum standards or carry out repairs
We will invest $50 million in establishing the regulator."

commitment: Implement the What Can Be Done model
specification: This policy would establish the ‘What Can Be Done’ model in Victoria, providing a residential therapeutic program for 14 to 17 year olds that appear before the Children’s Court of Victoria and who have significant substance use disorders.

commitment: Expand and upgrade Mildura Base Public Hospital
specification:
"Ensuring all Victorians have access to quality and timely healthcare is a top priority for our team, and a future Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will deliver a $180 million upgrade for Mildura Base Public Hospital, including:
• An expanded emergency department with an additional 18 beds.
• A new Medical Assessment and Planning Unit to provide rapid assessment, diagnosis and short-term care for patients diverted from the emergency department.
• A new 30 bed acute ward to support admissions and improve patient flow.
• New modular accommodation of 80 rooms to help recruit and retain staff, including nursing graduates and medical students on clinical placements, as well as allied health and visiting specialists and surgeons."

commitment: Limit the scope of suppression orders
specification: "A future Liberals and Nationals Government will end the abuse of suppression orders in Victoria by limiting their scope."

commitment: Close loophole in sentencing offenders convicted of assaulting emergency workers
specification: "Our laws will close the loophole in the existing legislation and ensure [emergency services] workers are protected throughout their entire shift."

commitment: Successful School Starters
specification: "Liberal education spokesman Brad Rowswell will announce his $156 million Successful School Starters policy pledge on Wednesday ... Under the proposed program, occupational therapists and speech pathologists would be embedded in the existing Primary School Nursing Program, helping to identify neurodiverse students at the start of their schooling."

commitment: Fast-track planning regulations for plug-in 'balcony solar' systems
specification: "The Greens will fast-track regulations to make Plug-in Balcony Solar Systems a reality in 2027, including laws to give renters rights to install balcony solar. We’ll also change planning rules to make new apartment buildings balcony solar ready. "

commitment: Introduce a Green Power Voucher scheme
specification: "The Greens will commit $500 million to Greens Power Vouchers and free energy assessments for renters." "The Greens will save you money through a new Greens Power Voucher scheme, which can be put towards energy efficient appliances and home upgrades [and] the price of electric cars and bikes, as well as two-way chargers so you can power your house with your electric car."

commitment: Abolish lease break fees
specification: "The Victorian Greens say lease break fees should be abolished ... It comes after the government announced that lease break fees will be capped but the Greens say that renters shouldn’t be forced to pay fees at all."

commitment: Build upgraded Collingwood health facility with co-located community housing
specification: "The Greens have renewed urgent calls for the Victorian Government to build cohealth’s shovel ready plan for an upgraded Collingwood health facility with co-located community housing. It comes after the recommendations from the independent review of cohealth general practice and related services were released on Wednesday, which recommended that the Victorian Labor Government go back to a proposal to redevelop the Collingwood community health facility."

commitment: Fair Share Guarantee
specification: "Under this commitment, 25 per cent of all new Victorian Government infrastructure expenditure will be allocated towards projects such as schools, hospitals, roads, emergency services, mental health and other community infrastructure in regional Victoria."

commitment: Bank levy of 0.1% on the five biggest banks
specification: "With a quarterly levy of just 0.1% on the five biggest banks."

commitment: Double existing royalties on coal and gas
specification: "We will raise an extra $80 million a year by doubling existing royalties on coal and gas"

commitment: Double the tax on casino table games
specification: "Doubling the tax on table games at the casino."

commitment: Increase the tax on online gambling to 25%
specification: "Matching the ACT's rate of 25% tax on online gambling."

commitment: Increase the tax on property developers' windfall profits to 75%
specification: "We'll also increase the tax on property developers' windfall profits to 75%, raising an extra $400 million." (per year)

commitment: Scrap Labor's 70/30 new homes target
specification: "Scrap Labor's 70/30 target" (for 70 per cent of new homes to be built in established areas and 30 per cent built in growth areas)

commitment: Increase the tax on pokies up to 75%
specification: "Increasing the tax on pokies up to 75%."

commitment: Require data centres to use renewable energy and contribute to renewable energy projects
specification: "The Greens say data centres at minimum must provide for all their power needs with wind, solar and batteries and make a further financial contribution to accelerate the stalled offshore wind or high-voltage transmission projects that are currently delaying the state’s transition away from coal power."

commitment: We will never waste your money on statues of ourselves
specification: "If Victorians do me the honour of electing me their Premier later this year, I will never want a statue."

commitment: Recruit 3,000 additional police officers
specification: "Our plan to boost frontline safety will deliver 3000 more police."

commitment: Introduce a VPS executive salary cap
specification: "This pay cap will limit public sector executive salaries to the same level as the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court - currently $598,248 - and ensure remuneration is in line with community expectations." "Saving $20 million over a decade by capping excessive public service salaries." (Second quotation from 'Our Ten Year Plan' policy document)

commitment: Enshrine Victoria Police’s cannabis cautioning program into legislation
specification: "Victoria Police already recommend cautioning over arrest, so it needs to be legislated for clarity." "Enshrining cautioning in law will ensure clarity and even application of the law across all communities and, save police, court and human resources."

commitment: Redevelop the Haymarket roundabout
specification: "We’re calling on the State Labor Government to commit now to a planning and design process to kick-start the redevelopment of the [Haymarket] roundabout. This could be funded using existing Government transport budgets, like the West Gate Toll Road TAP program."

commitment: Abolish the GP tax
specification: "Removing Labor's emergency services levy and repealing taxes on schools, visits to the GP, short-stay accommodation and lifting the stamp duty free-threshold to $1 million for first home buyers."

commitment: Abolish the payroll tax on non-government schools
specification: Abolish the payroll tax on non-government schools.

commitment: Abolish the short stay levy
specification: "Removing Labor's emergency services levy and repealing taxes on schools, visits to the GP, short-stay accommodation and lifting the stamp duty free-threshold to $1 million for first home buyers."

commitment: Adult Crime, Adult Time
specification: "Expand adult sentencing provisions to cover a broader range of serious youth offences, increasing the current list from 8 offences under Labor’s Adult Time for Violent Crime to 20 in the first tranche."

commitment: Ban bikies and organised crime from major construction projects
specification: "We will ban anyone with known links to organised crime from gaining employment on Victorian major construction projects."

commitment: Create a Charter of Budget Honesty
specification: "A legislated Charter of Budget Honesty, requiring governments to deliver clear, accurate financial reports to restore trust in government and ensure financial accountability." "[And] if Victorians do me the honour of electing me their Premier, I make this pledge. I will never raise taxes in secret."

commitment: Create a real-time government expenditure tracker
specification: "A real time public expenditure tracker to allow you to see where your money is being spent, giving you confidence that your hard-earned money is being used on the services and projects that matter to you."

commitment: Deliver an Intergenerational Report
specification: "A Victorian first Intergenerational Report to provide a long-term view of our economic health."

commitment: Essential Services Guarantee
specification: "Under our Essential Services Guarantee, there will be no reduction to police, nurse, teachers, healthcare workers, firefighters and other essential services Victorians rely upon."

commitment: Establish a Royal Commission into crime and corruption on Victorian Government construction projects
specification: "[Jess Wilson] said a Coalition government, if elected on November 28, would direct the royal commission to expand its investigation into the entire trade union movement on construction sites; examine how the CFMEU’s factional power influenced the Labor government’s decision-making; and investigate all actions unions took under industrial relations laws to determine whether they were legitimate or spurious."

commitment: Establish new construction sector watchdog Construction Enforcement Victoria
specification: "Establish Construction Enforcement Victoria to enforce compliance with the Construction Industry Code on taxpayer funded building sites, restoring integrity to major projects."

commitment: Establish new taskforce to recover stolen money and seize assets born from corrupt and fraudulent activity
specification: "We will immediately set up a special taskforce within Victoria Police, working in collaboration with the AFP and the ATO, to seize assets relating to the criminality and fraud identified in the Watson Report on the CFMEU. This taskforce will use new laws on asset seizures that were passed by this Government in 2024, but that have never been used properly."

commitment: Exempt first home buyers from stamp duty up to $1 million
specification: "Exempt first home buyers from Stamp Duty up to $1 million."

commitment: Give IBAC new powers to trace corruption and require its reports to be released sooner
specification: "We will give Victoria’s corruption watchdog new powers to follow the money beyond government to end corruption. We will ensure Victorians have greater transparency of corruption investigations by making it easier to hold public hearings. Public hearings and investigations will be protected from political interference." (14 May 2026) "The Liberals and Nationals' proposed laws will establish a new legal requirement for the Independent Broad-based Anti-Corruption Commission (IBAC) to table its reports in Parliament as soon as possible." (17 June 2026)

commitment: Implement a hiring freeze for back-office public sector roles
specification: "A Wilson Liberal and Nationals Government will save taxpayers $22 billion across the next decade by implementing a hiring freeze for back-office public sector roles." "These savings will be achieved through natural attrition, not lay-offs."

commitment: Introduce new racketeering laws
specification: "We will introduce tough new racketeering laws that put crime bosses behind bars for longer. These laws will let police go after the leadership of a criminal organisation, where that organisation has engaged in a pattern of law-breaking behaviour, regardless of who committed the offence."

commitment: Land tax relief
specification: "We will start to reverse Labor’s 2023 land tax changes by lifting the land tax threshold back to $300,000 – not in one go, but calmly and methodically by $50,000 every year for five years."

commitment: More PSOs
specification: "Recruit 200 additional PSOs. Return PSOs to all 120 stations where they are planned to be removed. Work with Victoria Police to deploy PSOs to high-risk shopping centres and precincts." "PSO strike teams will patrol high risk shopping centres and precincts."

commitment: Payroll tax relief
specification: "Signalling Victoria is open for business by increasing the payroll tax threshold to $1.2 million by 2028-29, then reducing the metropolitan payroll tax rate to 4.8 per cent from 2030-31."

commitment: Precinct Structure Plans for timely delivery
specification: "A Liberal and Nationals Government will set clear end dates from commencement for all PSPs to enable proper sequencing and timely delivery in new suburbs."

commitment: Re-invest Growth Area Infrastructure Contributions (GAIC) into communities from which they are raised
specification: "Ensure Growth Area Infrastructure Contributions are re-invested into the local communities from which they are raised."

commitment: Reopen police stations
specification: "Reopen the more than 40 police stations closed or operating under reduced hours."

commitment: Repeal the Treaty process and First Peoples' Assembly
specification: "Saving $1 billion over the next 10 years by repealing Labor’s Treaty process and First People’s Assembly."

commitment: Stronger pursuit laws for police
specification:
"The Liberals and Nationals Plan will:
• Create a new offence: initiating a police pursuit
• Establish a presumption of pursuit liability
• Strengthen legal protections for police
• Increase sentencing for pursuit related harm
• Ensure police maintain operational discretion
• Establish criminal liability for pursuit related collisions
• Allow for automatic vehicle forfeiture"

commitment: Co-fund feasibility study to expand renewable diesel blend processing at Geelong refinery
specification: "The Labor Government will co-fund Viva Energy to undertake a feasibility study to expand renewable diesel blend processing at the Geelong Refinery."

commitment: Cancel VNI West, pause Western Renewables Link, review Victorian Transmission Plan
specification: "A full review of the Victorian Transmission Plan will enable the spiralling cost of new transmission lines to be put through a rigorous assessment process. [...] Western Renewables Link will be paused while the transmission review is undertaken." "A future Liberal and Nationals Government will not waste billions on a project that won't help keep the lights on and will cancel VNI West."

commitment: Establish new Urban Solar Parks
specification: "The Liberals and Nationals will establish new Urban Solar Parks to encourage solar and battery installations on commercial and industrial rooftops in urban areas, to generate renewable power closer to where it is needed."

commitment: Break Bail, Face Jail
specification: "We will close loopholes, end exemptions, and restore real consequences for criminal behaviour. Bail laws will be strengthened to put victims ahead of criminals. If you break bail, you will face jail."

commitment: Remove the emergency services levy
specification: "Our commitment to remove the emergency services levy – a tax on every single family home, business and farm in the state."

commitment: Review the impact of major projects on residential construction costs
specification: "Stop the spiralling costs of construction by reviewing the impact of Labor’s major project blowouts on the residential construction industry."

commitment: Cap rent increases
specification: "Our plan is to freeze rents for two years, to give wages the chance to catch up to rents, and ban rent increases in the first two years of every new tenancy. Then we’ll limit rent rises in any given year to wage growth of that year (or inflation if that’s lower)."

commitment: Close property investor loopholes
specification:
"The Greens will:
• Allow renters to stay put when their home is sold to another investor
• Guarantee renters’ right of return after renovations
• Introduce a 3-year re-leasing ban after a notice to vacate due to the landlord or a family member moving in
• Prohibit privacy invasions and continuous recordings at inspections"

commitment: Tax empty homes and shops
specification: "Double the vacancy tax. Just 40% of eligible homes pay the vacancy tax. We will enforce it like they do in Vancouver, so 90% of homes pay. Expand the tax to include commercial properties."
